title: 抵押贷款利率再次上升，但购房者看到了一些优势
content:
上周抵押贷款利率继续攀升，但购房者逐渐重返市场，或许是利用了竞争减少和价格下调的优势。根据抵押贷款银行家协会的季节性调整指数，这推动上周抵押贷款总需求较前一周上涨 1.9%。

贷款余额在 832,750 美元或以下的 30 年期固定利率抵押贷款的平均合同利率从 6.65% 增至 6.69%，贷款点数从 0.67 降至 0.62（包括贷款发起费）并支付 20% 的首付。这是自去年 8 月以来的最高利率。

因此，对每周利率变动高度敏感的再融资需求本周下降了 2%，仅比一年前同一周高出 7%。去年这个时候，30 年期固定贷款的平均水平仅高出 15 个基点。

购房抵押贷款申请本周增长 6%，同比增长 0.2%，基本持平。随着市场进入历史上最缓慢的夏季月份，潜在买家开始稍作休息。 CNBC 住房市场调查报告中的房地产经纪人似乎更愿意降价。

CNBC 的《与戴安娜·奥利克 (Diana Olick) 一起玩房地产》为房地产投资者提供了新的、不断变化的机会，每周发送到您的收件箱。

在此处订阅即可立即访问。

“许多市场不断增长的房屋库存正在支持更多的购买活动，”MBA 高级副总裁兼首席经济学家 Mike Fratantoni 表示。 “即将公布的数据显示，6 月通胀有所下降，但随着油价再次飙升，7 月数据中的改善似乎不太可能持续，因此抵押贷款利率可能会继续走高。”

根据《抵押新闻日报》的另一项调查，抵押贷款利率从本周开始甚至更高，与 5 月中旬以来的最后一个高点持平。与伊朗的战争的新升级掩盖了上周低于预期的通胀报告。

“对于那些希望分析简单的人来说，燃油价格足以解释这一走势。事实上，8 月汽油期货本周也刚刚触及 5 月 19 日的高点，与利率的往返走势完全一致，”《抵押新闻日报》首席运营官马修·格雷厄姆 (Matthew Graham) 写道。

title: 随着投资者准备获得更多收益，股票期货下跌，伊朗战争仍然是焦点：实时更新
content:
Stock futures fell early Wednesday as investors looked ahead to another busy day of corporate earnings, with several major technology and industrial companies set to report.

Futures tied to theDow Jones Industrial Averagedipped 24 points, or less than 0.1%.S&P 500 futuresandNasdaq-100 futureswere down 0.3% and 0.7%, respectively.

Earnings take center stage again on Wednesday, with reports due fromServiceNow,International Business Machines,Tesla,Texas Instruments,AlphabetandAT&T. Investors will be watching closely for updates on AI spending, cloud demand, corporate technology budgets and the outlook for the second half of the year.

Investors remain focused on whether strong demand for AI infrastructure and software will continue to justify elevated valuations across the technology sector as earnings season accelerates.

"Q2 earnings season is ramping up, but with most hyperscalers yet to report, the market is still waiting for the definitive read on how AI investment is being monetized and translated into future capital spending," said Julia Hermann, global market strategist at New York Life Investment Management.

The major U.S. averagessnapped a three-session losing streakon Tuesday, supported by better-than-expected earnings from blue-chip companies including3MandGeneral Motors, which helped ease concerns about the health of corporate America. Chipmakers also fueled the rally, with theVanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH)climbing 4% as investors rotated back into artificial intelligence-related names.

Investor attention is also attuned to developments in the Middle East after U.S. Central Command carried out its 11th consecutive night of strikes against Iran.

Oil prices jumped in early trading after U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio told the ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting in the Philippines on Wednesday that Iran is "not serious about talks."

If they're serious, we're serious. If they're not, then we will do what is necessary to protect our interests and also the interests of our allies," he said.

Rubio added Wednesday that the strait — a critical shipping route for oil and other vital commodities — remains a sticking point in bilateral talks, alleging that Iran "demands the right" to control the waterway. Allowing this to happen would set "a very dangerous precedent" for the world, he argued.

Oilextended its recent rallyas escalating tensions in the Middle East raised concerns about potential supply disruptions. Shortly before 5 a.m. ET, global benchmarkBrent crude futuresfor July delivery were 3.5% higher at $94.20, paring earlier gains. Front-monthU.S. West Texas Intermediate crudefutures were up 3.8% to trade at $87.56.

As of Wednesday morning, money markets were pricing in a 24.1% chance of a rate hike from the Fed this month, and a 69% chance of at least a quarter-point hike in September, according to the CME's FedWatch tool.

U.S. Treasury yields inched higher on Wednesday as investors mapped escalating tensions across the Middle East and mulled prospects for Federal Reserve monetary policy in the months ahead.

The yield on the10-year U.S. Treasurynote — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — was broadly flat at 4.626%.

The2-year Treasury noteyield, which more closely tracks short-term Federal Reserve interest rate policy, fell one basis point to 4.251%. The longer-dated30-year Treasury bondyield was flat at 5.132%.

Precious metals traded higher on Wednesday, with gold prices surging to a two-week high as the Middle East conflict continues to weigh on markets.

Gold futureswere last seen 1.17% higher, at $4,125.00, whilespot goldprices were trading at $4,120.32, a 1.08% rise.

Investors flocked to bullion — long regarded a safe-haven asset during bouts of volatility — as the U.S. launched strikes against Iran for the 11thconsecutive day.

Silver also advanced, withfuturesrising 1.26% to $59.86, asspot silverreached $59.52, an increase of 1.25%.

Other precious also edged up, with platinum gaining 1.36% to $1,659.80 and palladium trading 1.27% higher at $1303.00.

The pan-EuropeanStoxx 600was last seen trading 0.6% higher, erasing losses seen earlier in the trading session.

Mining, utilities and oil and gas stocks led gains, while tech stocks slumped, as investors pivoted to assets seen as safe during bouts of volatility.

Investors are assessing a slew of corporate earnings and developments in the Middle East, with fading hopes of a U.S.-Iran ceasefirepushing oil prices higherthis morning.

Shares of Airbus rose as much as 7% in morning trading after the aircraft manufacturer provided a business update on Tuesday after markets closed."Airbus disclosed a mid-term guidance that aligned well with current market expectations," said Deutsche Bank analyst Christophe Menard. "The positive surprise, however, came from the €5 billion three-year share buy-back."

Airbus now targets adjusted earnings before interest and tax of between 12 billion euros and 13 billion euros ($13.6 billion to $14.8 billion) in 2029, indicating commercial growth will not flatten out with wide-body aircraft and service growth in the cards.

Full-year 2026 guidance remains unchanged.

Oil prices were 4% higher on Wednesday morning following the 11th consecutive round of U.S. strikes against Iran overnight, as Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the Strait of Hormuz remains a sticking point between the two sides.

Shortly after 4 a.m. ET, global benchmarkBrent crude futuresfor July delivery were almost 4% higher at $94.23. Front-monthU.S. West Texas Intermediate crudefutures were up 3.8% to trade at $87.46.

Taiwan's Taiex climbed 1.34% to close at 44,825.78, led by technology stocks. AI server makerWiwynnand memory chip producerNanya Technologyboth surged 10%. TSMC however declined 0.41%

Mainland China's CSI 300 slipped 0.46% to 4,717.24.Hong Kong'sHang Seng Indexwas down 1% as of 3.17 a.m. ET.

EquinorChief Financial Officer Torgrim Reitan warned Wednesday that Europe is unlikely to reach its gas storage target ahead of winter, saying the region finds itself in a "very fragile" situation.

His comments come as energy market participants closely monitor a resumption inMiddle East hostilitiesand a steep fall in traffic through the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz.

"Even if, sort of, things normalize around Hormuz and we get back to normal trade flows, we do not believe that Europe will get to the target level of 80% storage fills before the winter," Reitan told CNBC's "Europe Early Edition" on Wednesday.

The Norwegian oil and gas major reported adjusted earnings before tax for the second quarter of$11.48 billion, in line with expectations and up sharply from$6.53 billionfrom a year ago.

The results were boosted by a surge in fossil fuel prices as the U.S.-Iran conflict continues to disrupt global energy supplies.

European shares opened in negative territory on Wednesday morning, as corporate earnings and the U.S.-Iran war remained in focus.

Shortly after the opening bell, the pan-EuropeanStoxx 600was almost 0.4% lower, with most sectors and all major bourses in the red.

Oil and gas stocks bucked the trend, rising as oil prices rallied amid a further escalation of fighting in the Middle East.

In a surprise move late on Monday,John Healeywas announced as newly minted Prime MinisterAndy Burnham's finance minister.

Just weeks earlier, Healey resigned from his role as defense minister, citing government unwillingness to spend sufficiently on security "at this time of rising threats."

As investors took Healey's new role as a sign that the government will commit to higher defense spending, analysts and market watchers told CNBC which stocks they were watching.

U.K. inflation cooled to 2.6% in the 12 months to June, slightly lower than expected.

Economists polled by Reuters had been expecting the annual inflation rate to reach 2.7% in June.

The U.K.'s inflation ratedropped to 2.8% in Apriland held at that level in May, with the government-regulated price cap on energy bills softening the full impact of the Iran war on the energy market.

The price cap isdueto rise by 13% later this summer, when energy costs will hit a 2-year high.

June's U.K. inflation print came in lower than the euro zone's 2.8% reading for June, and well below the U.S. inflation rate of 3.5% for June.

Shares of Samsung Electronics rose over 4% on Wednesday amid a broader rise in tech stocks in the region.

The company is also reportedly in talks to invest hundreds of millions of euros in artificial intelligence startup Mistral. The move is part of a funding round that could value the French company at about 20 billion euros ($22.8 billion), theFinancial Times reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

Shares of domestic rival SK Hynix were up over 5%.

Japanese chip stocks were also higher, withAdvantestclimbing 2.8% andTokyo Electronadding 1.8%.Renesas ElectronicsandSoftbank Groupadded over 6% and 1.1% respectively.

Oil prices edged higher on Wednesday as concerns over supply disruptions persisted after U.S. forces launched a fresh round of strikes on Iranian military targets.

Brent crude futures for September deliverygained 1.2% to $92.1 a barrel, whileU.S. West Texas Intermediatefutures added 1.09% to $85.26.

The renewed military exchanges come as mediators are reportedly seeking to revive diplomacy, having presented Washington and Tehran with a proposal for a 10-day ceasefire.

title: 卢比奥称伊朗“不认真”对待和谈 油价上涨 4%
content:
美国隔夜连续第 11 轮对伊朗发动打击后，周三上午油价上涨近 4%，国务卿马可·鲁比奥 (Marco Rubio) 表示，霍尔木兹海峡仍然是双方之间的症结所在。

美国东部时间上午 5 点前不久，7 月份交割的全球基准布伦特原油期货上涨 3.5%，至 94.20 美元，回吐了早前的涨幅。美国近月西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨 3.8%，收于 87.56 美元。

周三在菲律宾举行的东盟外长会议上，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，华盛顿仍然致力于外交，但指责德黑兰违反了双方就霍尔木兹海峡达成的协议。

“我们现在面临的问题是，他们并不认真对待谈判，”他说。 “如果他们是认真的，我们就是认真的。如果他们不是，那么我们将采取必要的措施来保护我们的利益以及我们盟友的利益。”

周二，美国中央司令部对伊朗进行了连续第十一次袭击。

中央司令部部队的目标是伊朗军事行动中心、海上能力、飞机机库、无人机存储设施和军事后勤基础设施。

该军事单位表示，这次袭击是卢比奥周三表示，该海峡是石油和其他重要商品的重要运输路线，仍然是双边谈判的一个症结所在，并声称伊朗“要求拥有控制该水道的权利”。他补充道，允许这种情况发生将为世界树立“一个非常危险的先例”。

“由于伊朗问题没有取得突破，市场焦点在过去 24 小时内又回到了通胀上，布伦特原油在一个多月以来首次收于 90 美元/桶以上，再次引发了人们对更广泛的滞胀冲击的担忧。今天早上，我们看到油价进一步上涨至 92 美元/桶以上，因此几乎没有迹象表明油价会有所回落。周三早上，德意志银行的 Jim Reid 在一份报告中表示：“美国隔夜确认已完成对伊朗连续第 11 晚的打击。”

随着能源价格持续攀升，投资者对美联储鹰派政策措施的押注不断增加。

“到周二收盘时，7 月份加息的可能性回升至 26%，这是自上周经济意外下行以来的最高水平。”美国消费物价指数 (CPI)，”里德周三写道。 “CPI 前一天为 45%，后天低至 10%。”

根据 CME 的 FedWatch 工具，截至周三上午，货币市场定价美联储本月加息的可能性为 24.1%，9 月至少加息 25 个基点的可能性为 69%。

ING 分析师在周三上午发布的一份报告中表示，“供应不断增加”随着美国和伊朗之间暂时停火的希望破灭，能源市场面临风险。

“在黑海，俄罗斯的 CPC 码头已停止从哈萨克斯坦接收石油，油轮持续受到袭击，装载暂停。”

“暂停时间越长，哈萨克斯坦被迫限制上游产量的可能性就越大。来自 CPC 码头的装货量非常可观，6 月份的装货量约为 170 万桶/天。”

title: 公民联合组织允许外国竞选捐款的条款吸引了民主党法案
content:
国会民主党人正在寻求堵住他们所说的2010年公民联合最高法院裁决所造成的漏洞，该裁决允许外国实体向美国选举输送资金。

该法案由马里兰州民主党众议员杰米·拉斯金(Jamie Raskin)和罗德岛州参议员谢尔登·怀特豪斯(Sheldon Whitehouse)牵头，并首先与CNBC分享，该法案将设立外资所有权门槛以确定哪些美国公司应该被禁止为竞选活动、投票倡议和公投做出贡献。

“罗伯茨法院在公民联合案中做出的鲁莽决定继续给美国民主带来灾难，让世界各地的寡头和独裁者对我们的选举施加影响，破坏我们的机构，”拉斯金在一份声明中说，他指的是首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨以及允许公司和外部团体无限支出的裁决拉斯金说，该提案将“根除腐败，确保我们的选举是由美国人民而不是外国寡头决定的”。 该法案被称为“从美国选举中获取外国资金法案”，自周三出台以来，众议院有超过 65 名民主党议员，参议院有 11 名民主党议员。在共和党控制参众两院的情况下，该法案在国会获得通过的可能性不大。

该法案出台之际，美国公司的外资股权自 20 世纪 90 年代以来猛增。在此之前，最高法院于 6 月决定取消对政党与公职候选人协调支出的限制。

外国人为美国选举捐款已经是非法的，但拉斯金和怀特豪斯的提案将把现有法律扩大到一些在美国注册且外资所有权超过一定门槛的公司。

例如，位于美国境外、拥有 50% 投票权股份、总股本或股份的商业实体。由外国人拥有的会员单位将被禁止提供政治捐款，就像那些位于美国境内、美国境外的单一外国人拥有或控制 1% 的投票权股份、总股本或会员单位等的会员单位一样。

拉斯金和怀特豪斯在第 118 届国会中领导了一项几乎相同的法案，尽管该法案没有在两院获得投票。

“由于灾难性的公民联合决定，外国参与者可以利用同样腐败的黑钱渠道，允许企业无限支出，”白宫在一份声明中表示。 “我们应该完全摆脱这些该死的东西，但这项法案至少可以保护我们的民主免受外国对手从暗中影响美国选举的影响。”

本月早些时候，众议院通过了一项由宾夕法尼亚州众议员布莱恩·菲茨帕特里克(Brian Fitzpatrick)和缅因州民主党人贾里德·戈尔登(Jared Golden)牵头的两党法案，该法案旨在禁止外国捐款淹没当地选票倡议、公投和罢免选举。参议院尚未就该措施进行投票。

“选票是自由人民自治的工具。任何外国政府、外国国民或外国利益都不应参与决定美国人所遵守的法律，”菲茨帕特里克在通过后的一份声明中表示。

title: 卡尔希在中期选举前推出预测市场选举中心
content:
预测市场平台Kalshi将推出一个新的中心，让政治迷能够了解许多事件合约的交易者如何看待中期选举的结果。

Kalshi的“中期选举中心”将让观察者了解投机者对美国个别选举的预期结果。参议院和众议院，基于每个市场和整个国家地图的最新赔率。

该中心还将提供民调平均值，以便观众可以看到预测市场赔率与选民统计调查显示的结果进行比较；联邦选举委员会针对个别候选人的最新筹款报告；以及来自各个渠道的精选新闻和分析。

该平台面向那些希望通过 Kalshi 数据获取见解但不一定进行交易的人。 Kalshi 表示，该平台大约四分之三的访问者不会根据合约进行交易，而只是寻找当前赔率。

在一份声明中，Kalshi 首席执行官塔里克·曼苏尔 (Tarek Mansour) 表示，预测市场具有独特的视角，认为它们很难被政治偏见渗透。

“它们打破了两极分化，向你展示了大众的智慧实际上相信什么，并得到真金白银的支持，而不是空谈，”曼苏尔说道。麻省理工学院毕业生，曾任 Citadel 交易员和高盛分析师。 “这种明确性现在很少见，而这正是人们通过中期选举中心得到的。”

政治中心的推出是卡尔希在 11 月中期选举之前增加其政治影响力的最新举措。今年 5 月，该平台推出了“美国实力指数”，即所谓的政治“标准普尔 500 指数”，用于跟踪哪个政党上涨、哪个政党下跌。

观察人士还认为，中期选举季可能会导致预测市场交易量再次激增，就像 2024 年总统选举期间发生的那样。与哪一方将在 2026 年赢得众议院和参议院相关的合同已经交易了超过 3000 万美元。

title: 食品价格下跌——但通胀预计将从此上升
content: Image source,iStock / Getty Images PlusImage caption,The ONS said food products such as chocolate and beef were falling in priceByEmer MoreauBusiness reporterPublished22 July 2026, 07:07 BSTUpdated 2 hours agoFood prices are rising at their slowest rate in nearly two years, as the cost of staples such as margarine and sugar has gone down.Supermarket price wars have helped drive down prices in the year to June, the industry says, as retailers work to tempt customers with summer deals.Inflation in the UK overall has fallen to 2.6% in the year to June, down from 2.8% in the year to May, according to the Office for National Statistics (ONS), driven largely by lower fuel and food prices.June's figure will be welcomed by new Prime Minister Andy Burnham and his government, but analysts warn the fall is temporary, as higher energy prices in July are expected to push inflation back up.Lower fuel costs also pushed inflation down, with prices at the pumpfalling for the first timesince the start of the war in the Middle East.Clothing costs fell as well due to the summer sales, with many retailers offering larger discounts than last year.Falling food pricesFood and non-alcoholic beverage inflation fell by 0.2% month-to-month, with sugar, chocolate and confectionery seeing the largest drop in price.Meat, particularly beef, and vegetable prices rose in June but the increase was smaller than the same time last year. Prices of oils, fats and dairy fell in June, compared to a year previously.Food inflation often has a lag of up to 13 months due to the supply chain, so any effects from the war in Iran could still be yet to come.Fuel prices at the pump fell in June after the US and Iran agreed to halt military operations and allow the key Strait of Hormuz to re-open.But the recent resumption of hostilities and a new jump in crude oil prices means inflation could spike again in the coming months.The British Retail Consortium (BRC) said lower food inflation was driven by "intense competition between supermarkets"."If retailers are to keep prices affordable for consumers in the long run, the Government needs to take practical steps to lower the everyday cost of doing business," BRC economist Harvir Dhillon said."Andy Burnham has taken immediate action to ease pressure on household budgets; he must now look to do the same for businesses."The new prime minister has pledged to make the cost of living a priority for his government, and new Chancellor John Healey said the lower rate of inflation was "news families want to hear" but "there is much more to do".The government announced on Wednesday morning that the bus fare cap in Englandwill be brought back down to Â£2 in January.That was after Burnham announced that VAT on domestic electricity billswould be scrappedfor the rest of the year from October.Healey said: "Both these changes are a win-win. They help keep inflation down, while helping people afford the essentials."Interest rate hike unlikelyThe latest inflation figure is still above the Bank of England's target of 2%, but Suren Thiru, chief economist at the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales, said a rate increase when the Bank meets next week is unlikely."Rate-setters may want to assess the impact of any measures announced by the new Prime Minister before deciding whether to tighten policy again," she said.She added that rising inflation will "likely become a more notable economic headache" for Healey, "squeezing his fiscal headroom, raising borrowing costs, and increasing financial market volatility".Yaelâ¯Selfin, KPMG's chief economist, said the June figure is likely to be the lowest of the year.Higher energy bills, brought about bya rise in Ofgem's price cap, will likely push inflation up again, she said."Although the impacts from the initial energy shock have so far been relatively limited, if energy prices remain high for longer, second-round effects risk feeding through into wages and more broadly across the economy."Sarah Coles, head of personal finance at AJ Bell, said: "The markets are still only expecting a single rate hike by the end of 2026, but it's expected to hit in September, with another potentially following in February."It means the most generous rates are likely to edge up. If you're in the market for a new savings account, it's worth keeping your eye open for a bargain and acting fast while it lasts."But she added: "There's miserable news for anyone in the market for a new mortgage. Mortgage rates had been falling across the board, but this week has seen them jump significantly."Related topicsCost of LivingInflationEconomicsMore on this story'I can't afford to turn the oven on': 7.4m households struggling to buy essentialsPublished9 hours agoVAT to be cut from household electricity bills in OctoberPublished19 hours agoBurnham caps most bus fares in England at Â£2 but pulls back from possible income tax cut

title: 特朗普计划从 2028 年起对仿制药征收关税，并推迟两年测试美国本土化进程
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，从 8 月 1 日起，进口到美国的仿制药将面临两年零关税，然后于 2028 年 8 月征收 100% 的关税，一年后升至 200%。

特朗普在周二的社交媒体上表示，分阶段实施的计划旨在推动仿制药制造商将生产转移到境内，并将关税升级描述为对那些不要在宽限期内在美国建造工厂和设施。

根据国会情报平台 Legis1 的数据，美国几乎所有处方药都含有仿制药，这些仿制药往往来自海外制造，涉及复杂的所有权结构。

辛里奇贸易政策主管黛博拉·埃尔姆斯 (Deborah Elms) 表示，最新的关税举措凸显了特朗普将低成本药品生产回流到美国的目标。

但在美国建立药品生产是复杂且成本高昂的，而且几乎所有投入仍将来自国外，埃尔姆斯说，并补充道，“我不确定即使是潜在的 200% 关税也会改变基本的数学计算。”

特朗普利用关税威胁和最惠国定价政策迫使制药商向美国人收取的费用不高于其他高收入国家的患者。

专利和专利产品的关税特朗普表示，品牌药物将保持不变。总统于 4 月 2 日根据第 232 条对专利药品和成分征收 100% 的关税，同时免除仿制药、生物仿制药和相关成分。大型制药商在 100% 关税税率生效前有 120 天的时间，而依赖合同制造商的小型制药商有 180 天的时间。

包括 Eli 在内的十几家主要制药商礼来公司、辉瑞公司和诺和诺德公司已与特朗普达成协议，以降低新药和现有药品的价格。这些协议是总统“最惠国”政策的一部分，该政策将美国药品价格与更便宜的国外药品价格挂钩，并在三年内免除这些公司的关税。

这对印度来说风险很大，因为该国制药公司供应了美国消费的所有仿制药的近 50%。美国每年约占印度药品出口的三分之一，其中大部分是流行药品的廉价版本。中国公司在阿莫西林和肝素等活性药物成分的上游供应中占据主导地位。

Teneo 南亚顾问 Arpit Chaturvedi 表示，即使有两年的缓期执行，这一公告也大大增加了印度制药商的长期风险。查图尔维迪表示，制药行业是印度最大的净出口收入来源之一，全面实施特朗普规定的关税将对印度的贸易平衡造成严重打击。

他表示，与此同时，华盛顿将发现很难简单地取代印度作为供应商。

由于许多普通仿制药的利润已经非常微薄，如果批发商拒绝吸收或转嫁增加的成本，从而使特定产品的成本下降，一些制造商可能会完全退出特定产品。他说，不再“具有商业可行性”。

然而，两年的跑道为新德里在与美国正在进行的谈判中推动关税减免提供了一个关键的谈判窗口，包括承诺企业在美国的投资承诺。

由于规定的关税要到 2028 年（美国大选年）才会生效，“新德里希望这一规则不会得到实施，” Chaturvedi 说道。

与此同时，他预计印度制药商将游说华盛顿寻求豁免、寻求美国食品和药物管理局的批准、合同制造交易以及多元化进入新市场。

title: 家庭正在慢慢消失的行政区
content: Image caption,Tiphanie Frutuoso and her husband had their first baby this year and are moving out of London back to Luxembourg, partly because childcare is freeByMeghan Owen,ÂLondon work and money correspondent,ÂReporting fromIslingtonÂandÂJonathan Fagg,ÂEngland Data UnitPublished22 July 2026, 06:15 BSTIslington seems, on the surface, a family-friendly area. Parents push buggies through quiet leafy side streets of this popular neighbourhood that is also within easy reach of central London.But this north London borough has one of the lowest fertility rates in the country and mothers are older on average here than in most other parts of the capital.Islington is a snapshot of a trend also playing out not only in inner Londonbut also other parts of the world.The situation has been described by the London Assembly as an "existential challenge" for the city as a whole, so what are the reasons behind this and what can be done about it?Keen to find out more about family life in Islington, I joined a Zip-Zap baby music class to speak to parents.Tiphanie Frutuoso and her husband had their first baby this year."My husband and I have a one-bedroom flat â a two-bedroom is super expensive."Childcare is Â£2,000-Â£3,000 a month."They are moving back to Luxembourg, partly because childcare is free."It's really sad because we love London. We have better job opportunities here," Frutuoso added.Image caption,Tina Meschino had her first child at 41 as she wanted to get to an executive level firstTina Meschino had her first child at 41."I've always been career-driven. I moved to London from Australia for career opportunities."It's taken a while to get to where I want to be â an executive position â which felt like the right time to start a family."But she added that it was very difficult to find a suitable home with enough space, within budget.Samantha Nagaratnam had her daughter at 35."I was moving forward in my career and was really, really focused on that. But nobody tells you how hard it is [to fall pregnant]. It took about three years when we started trying."Originally from Toronto, she said it was much harder to find a family home in Islington with enough space.Zip-Zap co-founder Laura Edwards says families are moving out of Islington to other boroughs for better schools, more affordable homes and more space."It's going to have huge implications in 40-50 years when there's nobody to do the jobs and support the economy."'My living room is my bedroom'Some families have told me they have decided to stay in the borough but it is proving to be really difficult.Father-of-two Patrick Penny-Annang has lived in Islington all his life and now shares a one-bedroom flat with his family."Our living room becomes our bedroom... our one bed becomes the kids' room," he said."Islington is a lovely area to live in but because of that it's really expensive."Schools have been closing, schools that I used to go to."Image source,Patrick Penny-AnnangImage caption,Patrick Penny-Annang sleeps in the living room with his wife because they can't afford a two bedroom flatBetween 2013 and 2023, London's population of 0â9-year-olds fell by 99,100, despite the capital's overall population growing by 506,000.The decline,externalhas been steeper in inner than outer London."It's an existential challenge for London," says Bassam Mahfouz, chairman of the London Assembly's Economy, Culture and Skills Committee.Image caption,Bassam Mahfouz says London needs to treat falling numbers of children as an "emergency"His committee's recent report,externalrecommends pursuingUNICEF Child Friendly City status,external, introducing child-friendly housing standards, and mapping play and recreation spaces across boroughs."We need to tackle this as an absolute emergency."What's happening in Islington is happening right across London," he said, warning the trend threatens the city's workforce.He is urging the government and the mayor to "redouble their efforts" to ensure "children are growing up in every postcode".'Gut instinct' not to have kidsThe fertility ratemeasures the number of children born per woman of childbearing age,external.At 0.99, Islington has thesecond-lowest total fertility rate,externalin the capital after the City of London, and one of the lowest in England.To put it in perspective, the estimated number of children born per woman fell to just under 1.4 for England and Wales in 2025, down from 1.9 in 2010.BBC England's data unit analysed some of the factors that may be contributing to Islington's low rate:Young women leaving: In 2025, Islington recorded a net loss of 1,062 women aged 30-34, one of the biggest declines for that age group in the countryHigh rents:In 2023-24, renters spent 46% of the median local income on rent, giving Islington the ninth-highest rent-to-income ratio among 316 councils in England and Wales and only eight boroughs â all in London â ranked higherUnaffordable housing:In 2025, the median house price was almost 12 times the median annual income, placing Islington among the 40 least affordable local authorities in EnglandSocial housing demand:As of 31 March 2025, 16,794 households were on Islington's social housing waiting list â the 17th highest in England and sixth highest in LondonExpensive childcare:Parents paid an average Â£9.39 an hour for two-year-olds - the 12th highest in England.Image source,Francesca Baker-BrookerImage caption,Francesca and her husband Andy have decided not to have childrenFrancesca Baker-Brooker, 39, who works in PR, and her husband Andy, 41, an accountant, have decided not to have children.The couple live in a two-bedroom flat in Islington. They both say they shared a "gut instinct" early in their relationship that parenthood was not for them."We like our lifestyle - we like running, going to festivals and gigs," Francesca said.Soon after that conversation, they moved from a three-bedroom house in Kent to a two-bedroom flat in Islington and Andy had a vasectomy."I don't know how feasible it would have been to move to London if we'd wanted to start a family," Andy said.When people ask if he has a family, Andy says his answer is: "I have a family â my wife."They say about half of their friends in London do not have children, although they believe that is far less common outside the capital."I think it definitely is easier to be child-free in London," he added.Katie Beck, a policy fellow at the London School of Economics' LSE Cities, said: "People want to have children in London, but there are barriers â namely the cost of living and childcare."People are not able to stay in London to have children, or once they do they're moving to outer boroughs or leaving London altogether."Image caption,Katie Beck, a policy fellow at the London School of Economics' LSE Cities, says children are an "indicator species" representing a healthy cityBeck says London's falling rates of children reflects a wider global trend, driven by housing and childcare costs, more women entering higher education and the workforce, changing parenting expectations, fewer teenage pregnancies, and growing concerns about the future.She points to boroughs such as Islington, where high poverty, limited green space, expensive housing and dense populations contribute to particularly low child populations.Image caption,Students Jess, Charlotte and Milly say it is difficult for their generation to imagine having children in central LondonI was keen to find out what the younger generation think, so spoke to a group of students.Jess Rolf, 23, says having children was "never something she worried about", and trying to build a settled life was "very stressful with the cost of living and the job market"."I'm from Lincolnshire and people my age back home are buying houses with their partners and talking about starting families."I don't think that's on the cards for me."Charlotte Ward, 26, has said planning ahead is difficult."A lot of people our age are quite disenfranchised."You put all your energy into school, university and work, then wonder, 'do I want to bring somebody else into that if I can't even support myself right now?'"When parents or grandparents ask 'what happens when you have children?', I can say, 'I might not'."There's a small element of emancipation from the expectation that you definitely will have children but if I'm progressing in my career and my male counterparts don't have to take time out to have a child, that could put me at a disadvantage."Millicent Angel, 24, says it is hard to envisage a future when the world feels "so unstable" but she still definitely wants children.She adds there's "a million and one things" she would like to do first, including developing her career.Children 'a sign of a healthy city'Beck argues that "children are an indicator species"."They are a sign of a healthy city. If you see a dearth of children, that rings alarm bells that a city is not functioning as it should," she added.She describes a child-friendly city as one that is accessible, with active transport and safe affordable housing.As the independent think tank Centre for London points out: "London is not becoming a city without families with children, but it is becoming a place where the realities that families with children face are increasingly unequal."A spokesperson for the Mayor of London, Sir Sadiq Khan said: "The mayor wants London to remain a city for everyone â where people can afford to put down roots, raise a family and build a future."That is why tackling London's housing crisis and increasing the supply of genuinely affordable homes is one of his top priorities, alongside measures to support families with the cost of living, including funding free school meals for every child in a state primary school

title: 特朗普推动美国制造的人工智能芯片打击台积电的利润
content:
唐纳德·特朗普总统要求其在美国制造先进半导体的压力，导致全球领先芯片制造商台积电的成本上升，利润率受到挤压。

特朗普于 2025 年重新掌权后，总统多次威胁要对不在美国生产产品的公司征收关税。

此后，台积电宣布了总计 2000 亿美元的对美国芯片制造商的承诺。该公司表示，尽管在人工智能热潮的推动下，台积电的市值在过去 12 个月内增长了 100% 以上，但海外扩张对本季度的巨额盈利造成了打击。

毛利率高于预期，但被海外晶圆厂的稀释所抵消。黄文德尔在财报电话会议上表示。他补充说，随着海外晶圆厂项目的“增加”，未来“几年”的利润将进一步被稀释。

美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克在一份声明中表示，“特朗普总统的领导力正在推动企业投资美国制造业。”

“台积电在与台湾达成历史性贸易和投资协议后宣布追加投资 1000 亿美元，这将为美国创造数以万计的就业机会，并将先进的半导体制造业带回美国。”美国。”

虽然包括 SK 海力士在内的其他亚洲芯片制造商正在开发美国工厂，但台积电迄今为止做出了最大的承诺。其在美国的积极扩张使其面临更高的生产成本，从而对利润率造成潜在的阻力。

台积电周四报告称，第二季度利润同比增长 77.4%，飙升超过预期，标志着这家全球最大代工芯片制造商的季度业绩又创历史新高。

该公司还在美国积极扩张，因为该公司继续看到其客户（台积电的客户）的“多年需求大趋势”。黄告诉 CNBC。

政治压力是海外扩张的另一个关键驱动因素。

白宫发言人向 CNBC 表示：“台积电和其他半导体公司的数万亿美元投资是特朗普总统贸易和经济政策的结果，从与台湾的历史性贸易协议到重新谈判的 CHIPS 计划投资。”

在美国建设的成本要高得多。

“总的来说，我们估计台积电在美国生产的芯片的成本比在台湾生产的芯片高出 20-50%，具体取决于补贴时间、税收抵免认可和其他成本波动，”晨星公司高级股票分析师菲利克斯·李 (Phelix Lee) 告诉 CNBC。 Lee 补充道，他预计客户将承担更多更高的生产成本。

据《日经新闻》周二报道，台积电计划在 2027 年将先进和成熟芯片生产的价格提高最多 10%。台积电告诉 CNBC，它不会对定价发表评论。

Gartner 副总裁分析师 Gaurav Gupta 向 CNBC 表示，“对台积电有帮助的是缺乏任何实质性竞争。”

由于台积电在尖端节点市场占据主导地位，“增加的成本的很大一部分必须由其客户承担，这些客户正在寻求多元化或获得美国政府的授权购买本地芯片，”Gupta

该公司预计，未来几年海外晶圆厂的扩张将导致毛利率稀释，初期为 2% 至 3%，后期将扩大至 3% 至 4%，黄说。

“这是台积电能够承受的利润差，因为其整体利润率非常高。”D.A. 技术研究主管 Gil Luria 表示。戴维森。台积电第二季度毛利率为 67.7%，略高于第一季度的 66.2%。

虽然特朗普加倍呼吁本土制造，但晨星公司的 Lee 表示，“在新冠疫情扰乱全球供应链后，客户越来越寻求地域多元化。”

“客户正在为地缘政治、物流和其他供应链中断做好准备。”他补充道。 “我们预计，美国制造的压力将在特朗普当选后持续存在，尽管目前尚不清楚胡萝卜加大棒政策将如何分配。”

title: 这些日本人工智能赢家并不生产芯片。他们制造厕所、玻璃纤维和调味料
content:
At a time when investor attention has been on the semiconductor industry, some hidden gems with businesses quite dissimilar to high tech have turned out to be market winners, riding the AI boom.

Toto is best known for high-end toilets, Nittobo makes textiles and glass fiber, and Ajinomoto makes MSG seasoning. Their shares have gained 78%, 63% and 61%, respectively, this year, as they make use of their core technologies to benefit from the AI supply chain.

Toto makes ceramic electrostatic chucks used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, while Nittobo supplies advanced glass fiber used in semiconductor package substrates.Ajinomoto makes insulating material, known as "build-up film" or ABF, used in semiconductor packaging for high-performance computers and data-center servers.All three companies reported sharp growth in businesses tied to semiconductor demand for their full financial years ended March 31, highlighting the impact of the AI boom.

The company's advanced ceramics business enjoyed higher profit margin than its housing equipment segment, thanks to demand from IoT, digital transformation, AI and data centers for advanced semiconductor equipment.Toto, in itsfull year results, said it saw a decrease in sales and profits for its core 100-year-old housing equipment unit, but this was made up by increases in revenue and profits in its advanced ceramics business.

The segment saw a 34% increase in annual revenue and 42% jump in operating profit, almost single-handedly pulling the overall company into growth for the financial year.

The company's expertise in ceramics led it to manufacture electronic chucks for semiconductor manufacturing equipment in 1988.

These chucks hold silicon wafers in place during the etching process inside semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Toto says that their ceramics significantly contribute to improving the manufacturing yield of advanced chips."However, we do not view one segment as superior to the other. Our Advanced Ceramics Business is a high-growth area, but we endured long periods of deficits over its 40-year history before reaching this point," the company said to CNBC in an email.It plans to grow both segments and "maintain a balanced ratio" for sustainable overall growth, and "absolutely no plans" to pivot away from its core housing equipment business, as it provides a stable foundation for the company's balance sheet, while the chip sector remains volatile.

Nittobo said electronic materials were already its mainstay, as it continues to develop markets for its traditional glass-fiber business. Its T-glass product, launched in 1984, is used in printed circuit boards, and electronic components.The company told CNBC that its T-glass and other electronic materials are "the pillar" of its growth for the next decade, and that AI semiconductor demand was changing how it allocates capital expenditure, research and development, and human resources.Nittobo's resultstell the story: the company said that strong demand related to AI servers, as well as factors such as strong sales of "Special Glass" pushed up sales and profits for the electronics materials business segment.

Net sales in the electronic materials business climbed 20.4% year on year and operating profit climbed 39.7% compared to the previous financial year.

That segment contributed about 91% to Nittobo's net sales increase in the last financial year, according to CNBC's calculations, with the segment's profit rising by 5.5 billion yen (about $34 million), more than the company's operating profit increase of 4.4 billion yen.

The company said glass fiber has been used in many applications over time, including composite materials for plastic reinforcement, but now, the company sees that there is a "very strong possibility electronic materials will remain its most important business well into the future."

In its results release, Nittobo said it "expects to see strong demand for Special Glass used in electronic materials, particularly for servers at data centers, network equipment, and semiconductor package substrates, and will proactively strengthen its efforts to expand production capacity to meet this demand."

While semiconductor segment becomes increasingly lucrative for the company, it is also expanding applications for its traditional glass-fiber businesses, including composite and industrial materials.

Ajinomoto has found applications for its products, such as producing the ABF insulation film used in semiconductors, even as food remains its primary focus.

According to Ajinomoto's website, a byproduct from the MSG manufacturing process helped the company develop technologies that eventually led to the creation of ABF.

The product was put on the market in 1999, and is currently used for high-performance semiconductors, including CPUs.

Ajinomoto says ABF's role has become more important as semiconductor packaging has grown more complex, and that AI, 5G and other advanced technologies will continue to drive semiconductor demand.

The company did not respond to CNBC's request for comment.

Ajinomoto does not break out ABF into its own segment, but said in itsfull year resultsthat its "Healthcare and Others" segment — which include ABF — saw an increase in revenue of about 4% and business profit rising 45.1% year on year, partly due to higher revenue for electronic materials.

That segment, which makes up more than a third of the company's profit for this financial year, even surpassed Ajinomoto's frozen food segment in terms of revenue and profit.

"We foresee continued growth centered on ABFTM products in high-value-added and cutting-edge fields,"the company said.

The company said it aims for a "one-to-one balance" between its food business and its AminoScience business, with ABF contributing to the latter.

title: 国会议员敦促通过削减雇主的国民保险来增加青年就业
content: 图片来源，盖蒂图片社作者：米切尔·拉比亚克 (Mitchell Labiak) 商业记者 46 分钟前发布 一群国会议员敦促，应削减所有 25 岁以下的雇主国民保险 (NI) 缴款，以增加年轻人的就业机会。工作和养老金委员会表示，它已听到“压倒性证据”表明，包括雇主 NI 在内的就业成本上升，正在减少培训和职位空缺，特别是年轻人。超过 100 万 16 至24岁的人不上学、不就业、不培训（称为Neet）。该委员会表示，削减所有25岁以下青年的雇主NI将解决这一“讽刺”问题。政府表示，决心为年轻人创造机会，改革教育，支持人们留下来并在工作中取得进步。上届政府去年为企业增加NI，当时表示，他们为公共服务提供资金是做出正确的选择。在2024年选举宣言中，工党表示不会提高“劳动人民”的税收，特别是所得税、NI或增值税。批评者一些雇主认为，由于最低工资的提高和雇主国民保险缴款的增加，雇用年轻人变得更加困难，尽管财政研究所（IFS）发现没有明确的证据，外部表明更高的最低工资是年轻人成为啃老族的“主要驱动力”。去年4月，雇主支付的NI缴款比例从13.8％上升到15％，他们开始为每位雇员的工资缴税的起征点从每年9,100英镑下降到5,000英镑。然而，就业津贴，即雇主可以从NI账单中索回的金额，从5,000英镑上升到10,500英镑。委员会表示，雇主NI已经打击了零售和酒店业，据称这些行业往往特别严重雇用年轻人。它补充说，雇主之间存在“差距”政府针对 21 岁以下人员的就业战略以及针对 25 岁以下人员的战略。委员会表示：“虽然企业无需为 21 岁以下雇员或 25 岁以下学徒支付雇主 NI 缴款，除非他们的工资高于 50,270 英镑的门槛，但他们为 21 岁至 24 岁的非学徒支付年收入超过 5,000 英镑的 15%，这破坏了政府计划该委员会还表示，存在“政策矛盾”，培训人员的福利削减破坏了政府鼓励学徒制的动力，并将“缺乏一致性”描述为“不可原谅”。该委员会主席黛比亚伯拉罕表示，政府需要制定统一的青年就业战略来解决这些矛盾。“这将提高政策的一致性，因此任何政策都不会无意中阻碍帮助更多年轻人的努力她说。委员会欢迎早期采取措施，优先考虑 18 至 24 岁年轻人的工作和培训机会，但表示需要做出改变来解决尼特人问题。亚伯拉罕斯说，“即使在一个人的成长过程中短暂地成为尼特人，也会损害心理健康，影响未来的职业机会，并减少终生收入。”前部长艾伦·米尔本在对青年失业问题的审查中发现，政府在年轻人福利上的支出是支持年轻人的支出的 25 倍。今年 5 月发布的中期报告还发现，在没有解决方案的情况下，未来五年内，六分之一的年轻人将成为尼特族，而目前这一数字为八分之一。该报告还估计，尼特族每年因福利支付和经济产出损失给英国造成约 1,250 亿英镑的损失。报告称，造成这场危机的因素并非单一因素，包括 Covid-19 大流行、智能手机、健康问题以及当前急剧恶化的就业市场。入门级职位数量下降。一位政府发言人表示：“长期以来，政府为失败付出了代价，而不是为人们的成功进行投资。我们决心扭转这一局面，为年轻人创造真正的机会，改革教育，让每个人都有一条通往好工作的明确道路，并为人们留下来继续工作提供支持。”面对对NI加息的批评发布2024年11月3日发布里夫斯公布8.2亿英镑资金支持失业年轻人发布2025年11月26日发布尼特代表什么以及为什么英国有这么多？发布29月

title: 人工智能会帮助你完成你的工作还是取代你？
content: ByFaisal Islam,ÂEconomics editor,ÂPhil Leake,ÂMiguel Roca-Terry,ÂData journalistsÂandÂJess Carr,ÂData designerArtificial Intelligence (AI) companies are making vast claims about the ability of their tools to replace human labour.Some jobs will be automated, others will be "augmented". The bosses of the world's biggest companies are diverting vast sums into these tools, partly with the knowledge that they could save money on headcount."Flat is the new up", we are told, in terms of the size of a company's workforce as investors ask whether jobs should be done by new recruits - or, instead, armies of "AI Agents", virtual workers tasked with doing specific roles, some of them relatively skilled.If even half true there will be an impact on us all, across sectors and individual careers, and perhaps it will happen sooner than we think.Nobel prize-winning economists recently warnedthe world âmust act nowâ,externalto ensure that AI leads to rising living standards and not large-scale job displacement, and last month London businesses warned they werestruggling to find the skills they needas AI disrupts the jobs market.It is early days yet, but there are already some notable patterns in the data.This chart is the industry benchmark for how various models can perform the tasks previously done by humans, in this case using and developing computer software.This measure showed that three years ago, large language models (LLMs) were only able to reliably complete tasks humans took seconds or minutes to do. Now they are increasingly able to complete fairly complex tasks taking an hour or so.Now, some of the LLMs can find problems in a cryptocurrency contract and even develop and streamline the model itself, which would take a human several hours.The latest generation of models could start to entirely develop themselves in the next year or so. This is just software coding, but the same type of pattern is being seen, at an earlier stage, with financial analysis, early stage legal work, even some entry level creative industry jobs.What does that mean for jobs? The most thorough analyses out there come from the United States, using four years of data on employment outcomes by age among a range of occupations most exposed to AI (including software developers and customer contact reps) - and least exposed to AI (health workers, childcare workers, hairdressers).Stanford University's analysis of wage and jobs data finds a hit to employment for 22 to 25-year-olds of 2.7% since ChatGPT became widespread, rising to 12.8% in the most AI-exposed sectors such as finance, software and creative industries.Not all economists agree, arguing that other factors such as interest rate rises can explain this.Online jobs postings have also been affected since the launch of ChatGPT and other LLMs.There are many other factors here, from interest rates to taxes, however there is something of note in the OECD's recent analysis of the difference in jobs posting between its slightly different measure of highly exposed sectors (eg telemarketing and legal services) and less exposed sectors (construction, cleaning and food prep).The UK was hit quite notably on this measure at a time when rates were stable or being cut. It also predates last year's National Insurance rise. On most international measures, the UK's service sector concentration leaves it exposed to potential AI jobs losses.AI usage is measured in "tokens", which are small chunks of text that AI systems use to understand, analyse and generate language. On average, one token is roughly equivalent to three-quarters of an English word.There have been astonishing increases in AI use in 2026, and the increase in token use has vastly outweighed the declining âper token costâ.The world's top companies that are using AI had deployed "token leaderboards" to try to get their employees to create as much gain in productivity as possible from the most advanced models.Trillions, and sometimes thousands of trillions of tokens (quadrillions) have been used over the past few months primarily for âagentic useâ, which is for agents that can perform tasks automatically. The problem here is that incredible bills were racked up, so much so that many of those companies have now begun to ration the use of these models.This is important. It might show that there are limits to how much work could be automated. The virtual workers might be more expensive than the human ones. It depends on the task.One factor to watch out for however, is that many companies, including Western ones, are diverting to much cheaper forms of AI, derived from Chinese models that are provided freely on to the market.So there is much uncertainty here, but some clear trends emerging.Related topicsArtificial intelligenceEmployment

title: 摩根大通的杰米·戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)对国债市场做出了看跌的预测。许多投资者已经采取行动
content:
关注股市并寻找方法让投资组合应对潜在股市低迷的投资者通常会转向美国国债市场，将其作为“逃向安全”的配置。但如果您遵循摩根大通首席执行官杰米戴蒙本周发布的股票和债券市场双重警告，您最好保持短期国债敞口。

事实上，这正是许多投资者在过去一年中一直在做的事情，并且在 6 月和 7 月继续这样做。虽然投资者继续向股票 ETF 增加创纪录的资金——美国 ETF 市场的资产在年中达到了超过 1 万亿美元，而股票 ETF 几乎占了总资产的一半——但许多投资者自己呼吁留在国债市场的空头。

过去一年的 ETF 流量数据显示，投资者一直在涌入短期国债基金，其中 iShares 0-3 个月国债ETF(SGOV) 今年从投资者那里获得的资金比任何其他债券 ETF 都多。根据 ETFAction.com 的数据，该 ETF 的投资者净流入增加了 475 亿美元。它已成为第三大债券 ETF，资产规模接近 1000 亿美元，仅次于 Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF (BND) 和 iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG)。

周一在接受 CNBC 撰稿人 Wilfred Frost 采访时，戴蒙表示，除了他不会碰触的股票交易价格外，他也不会购买长期国债。他说：“10年期国债的利率可能应该在4%到4.5%之间。”

即使通胀开始回落，接近美联储2%的目标，美国最大银行的首席执行官表示，他认为长期政府债券的价格不会有太大上涨空间。

10年期国债目前的收益率为4.6%，并且今年大部分时间收益率都在走高。随着市场从美联储最终会降息的观点转变为加息可能性更大的观点。只要加息风险依然存在且通胀前景仍不明朗，与收益率走势相反的10年期国债价格就应该继续承受压力。对公共支出和赤字水平的更广泛担忧也加剧了对收益率的担忧。

根据 ETFAction 数据，过去一年，Vanguard Total Bond Market 和 iShares 0-3 个月国债 ETF 是唯一跻身流量前 10 名 ETF 之列的固定收益 ETF。 iShares短期国债基金总体排名第五，净流入近500亿美元。只有规模最大的 ETF——Vanguard、iShares 和 State Street 核心 S&P 500 基金，以及 Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF 才能超越。

短期国债势头全年持续，SGOV 在 6 月份所有 ETF 流量中排名第五。

短期国债是平滑市场波动的工具的想法并不新鲜，而且最著名的支持者是沃伦·巴菲特，他在 2013 年致伯克希尔·哈撒韦投资者的年度信中写道，他为妻子制定的遗产计划是 90% 的标准普尔 500 指数和 10% 的短期国债，这对于大多数长期投资者来说可能已经足够了。

title: 美联储对 Anthropic 的 Mythos AI 模型敲响了警钟，但不得不几个月没有使用它
content:
In April, theFederal Reserveand Treasury Departmentconvened an extraordinary meetingwith the CEOs of the nation's top banks. Officials rang the alarm bell about anadvanced new artificial intelligence modelthat could pose an unprecedented cybersecurity threat to the nation's top financial institutions.

Anthropic, the company behind the AI model,Claude Mythos Preview, said the offering excelled at identifying weaknesses and security vulnerabilities within software. The company released it to a select group of banks and other institutions as part of acybersecurityinitiative calledProject Glasswing.

For at least three months afterward, the Fed itself didn't have access to Mythos, leaving arguably the most systemically important global financial institution vulnerable, even as other institutions began to patch their weaknesses.

The Fed was still trying to get access to Mythos as of July 15. It isn't clear if the central bank has since gained access to the model.

Anthropic didn't immediately respond to a request for comment. The Fed declined to comment for this article.

The meeting in April happened under the previous leader of the Fed, Jerome Powell, who convened bank CEOs alongside Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, as CNBC reported earlier.But in little-noticed congressional testimony last week, Powell's successor, ChairmanKevin Warsh, told the Senate he was still working to secure access to Mythos and other cutting-edge AI models.

"We are not the deciders as to who has access, but I have not been shy in sharing my views with authorities across the government about the vulnerabilities, and have been asking for access not just for the Federal Reserve but for other institutions to a whole range of these new artificial intelligence models so that they can protect themselves," Warsh told Sen. Jack Reed, D.-R.I., in response to questions about Mythos.

Warsh clarified that there were other models the Fed needed access to as well.

"I wouldn't want to just isolate Mythos, though," Warsh said. "As these new models find their way more broadly, our banking system and frankly, the Federal Reserve needs to do all we can to patch any vulnerabilities that we have."

Warsh has embraced the adoption of AI in his brief time at the Fed, calling it a transformational technology.

It isn't clear the work to address vulnerabilities can begin without access to Mythos.

Anthropic unveiled Claude Mythos Preview and Project Glasswing in early April.

The company said roughly 50 organizations had access to the model at the time, but it named only a handful, including the bankJPMorgan Chase, and tech titans such asAmazon,AppleandGoogle. Anthropic said it had also been in "ongoing discussions with U.S. government officials" about the model, including the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and the Center for AI Standards and Innovation.

Anthropicexpanded accessto Project Glasswing in June, adding more than 150 organizations to the initiative across 15 countries. Daniel Newman, CEO of research firm the Futurum Group, said he was surprised to hear the Fed was not included.

"You would think that the financial institution that sort of drives all the policy for the rest of the financial institutions would be front and center of at least having a chance to evaluate the new technology," he told CNBC on Tuesday.

Mythos' rollout has sparked both intrigue and confusion in recent months, particularly as Anthropic's fraught relationship with the Trump administration caused complications.

In June, Anthropic said it had to disable access to Mythos 5, an updated version of the model, and Fable 5, a version of Mythos that it released more broadly, in order to comply with an export control directive from the federal government that cited "national security authorities."

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick granted the company permission to restore access to Mythos to a select group of "trusted partners," according to a letter viewed by CNBC. The export controls were laterlifted entirely.

The Trump administration has been taking a much more active role in AI regulation since President Donald Trump signed an AI executive order in June. But questions remain about who is calling the shots on AI policy behind the scenes, and the scrambling at the Fed — which Trump chose Warsh to lead — is another sign of chaos.

Chris Fall, head of theCenter for AI Standards and Innovation, resigned from his role as director just three months after he waspickedfor the job by the Trump administration, CNBC confirmed on Monday. Venture capitalistDavid Sackspreviously held the position of White House AI and crypto czar, but he stepped down from that role in March.

Chinese open-weight models aregaining steamagainst leading offerings from U.S. companies likeOpenAIandAnthropic, sparkingconcerns from tech executivesand government officials about the durability of the U.S. lead in the AI race. Moonshot AI, a Chinese startup, released a model calledKimi K3earlier this month that outperforms those companies across some industry benchmarks.

Sacks said in a post on X on Friday that Kimi K3's performance is "concerning," and that "America is tying itself in knots."

"This is how you lose the AI race," he wrote. "The rest of the world won't play by our rules if we bog ourselves down."

Futurum's Newman said the Fed is "certainly is going to play catch up" since it hasn't had access to the cutting-edge models that other agencies have.

"Every day, every week, whether it's China's innovation or U.S. innovation, technology leaders inside of large institutions are facing a constant barrage of net innovation," he said.

title: 东京敦促男性穿短裤上班，但一些女性称这是“腿毛骚扰”
content: 图片来源，盖蒂图片社作者：Kurumi Mori、东京通讯员和 Chie Kobayashi 2026 年 7 月 21 日发布随着今年夏天气温上升，日本男性在工作中比以往任何时候都更多地裸露腿部。东京都政府正在敦促公司员工放弃平常的西装和领带，换上更休闲的着装，包括 T 恤、运动鞋和短裤。东京都知事小池百合子 (Yuriko Koike) 介绍了“东京” 4 月份的“Cool Biz”，希望能扩大她标志性的降温举措，该举措现已成为广泛认可的年度夏季传统。近四个月以来，新允许穿短裤的办公室政策得到了褒贬不一的评价。一些评论员喜欢宽松的规定，帮助他们更舒适地工作。其他人则表示这项政策对女性不公平。虽然不是官方规定，更多的是出于礼仪考虑，但在传统的日本办公环境中，当工作服暴露双腿时，女性通常仍被要求穿紧身裤。还有一些女性描述了“腿毛骚扰”的经历，或者网上杜撰的一个术语“sunehara”，指的是被迫看到同事腿毛的不适。“我们希望在酷热的天气里给人们更多的选择，而不是告诉他们穿什么。只要工作服合适就应该没有问题。”东京都政府环境官员 Noboru Watanabe 告诉 BBC。图片来源：Getty Images Gorilla Clinic 6 月份的一项调查发现，53.5% 的人反对在夏天穿短裤上班，而 46.5% 的人赞成新建议。对于那些反对在办公室穿短裤的人来说，无论男女，主要原因都是对体型和体毛的担忧。该诊所表示，女性的反应明显多于男性，这表明女性可能更不愿意看到男同事裸露的双腿。 近年来，越来越多的日本工人，尤其是在初创公司和科技公司工作的工人，开始穿休闲装。但今年，东京政府的建议使其更容易被社会接受。尽管如此，一些男性还是对自己的腿毛感到不自在。大猩猩诊所的主任船津秋文说，他注意到越来越多的顾客来到诊所，不仅仅是为了美观，而且是为了“穿短裤时的社交礼仪”。他认为女性认为“男人应该少点腿毛”，这促使她们寻求激光脱毛，以免冒犯周围的人。日本气温飙升超过 40 摄氏度，标志着第一个“酷热天”。2 小时前发表 小池百合子在 2005 年担任日本环境大臣时首次提出了夏季着装转变。她发起了一项名为“Cool Biz”的全国节能运动，鼓励公司员工选择短袖衬衫。政府领导人参与了时任首相小泉纯一郎经常不穿领带或夹克出现在公共场合，帮助宣传这一倡议。几年后，2011 年 3 月东北地震和海啸发生后，政府启动了“超级酷商务”，扩大了指导方针，以帮助减少工作和家庭的能源使用。与世界其他地区一样，日本近几个月来经历了创纪录的高温，同时还要应对中东不稳定导致的能源价格飙升。预测者预测日本气象厅警告今年夏天将出现极端高温，日本气象厅试图通过宣布“kokusho-bi”一词来提高公众认识，该词的意思是“酷热的日子”，当汞温度超过 40 摄氏度时。根据日本消防和灾害管理局的数据，最新的每周数据显示，7 月 6 日至 12 日的 7 天内，日本有 7 人因中暑死亡，4,580 人入院治疗。在政府官员一再鼓励的最基本行动下，居民们开始转向新产品和小玩意来避暑。内置风扇的衣服、一次性湿毛巾、防紫外线和隔热雨伞、便携式手持风扇等物品在全国商店中很受欢迎并出售。日本减灾学术网络的专家强调，身体需要几周的时间才能适应高温。他们说，关键是要开始为炎热的天气做好准备，并采取措施预防中暑。在该国的雨季期间，在盛夏到来之前。日本还面临着高湿度，这使得汗水更难蒸发，从而降低了身体自我冷却的能力。相关主题亚洲日本气候

title: OpenAI 任命两名新董事会成员
content:
OpenAI 表示，随着公司距离预期 IPO 越来越近，它任命了长期担任财务高管的 David Vélez 和 Robin Vince 加入其非营利性和营利性董事会。

Vélez 是拉丁美洲最大的数字银行 Nubank 的首席执行官，Vince 是金融服务公司 BNY 的首席执行官。 OpenAI 在周二的声明中表示，两人将为该公司提供“关于技术如何重塑行业和推动经济增长的互补观点。”

此次任命正值估值超过 8500 亿美元的 OpenAI 为潜在的大规模首次公开募股做好准备。该公司于 6 月份向美国证券交易委员会秘密提交了招股说明书，但尚未透露计划上市的正式时间表。

OpenAI 于 10 月份进行了资本化，巩固了其作为非营利组织 OpenAI 基金会的结构，并在其营利性业务 OpenAI Group PBC 中拥有控股权。该公司在当时的一份新闻稿中表示，该非营利组织的股本估值约为 1300 亿美元，此后该组织一直被誉为世界上资源最丰富的非营利组织之一。

“David 和 Robin 是杰出的领导者，他们利用技术重塑金融服务并在全球范围内扩大机会，”OpenAI 基金会和 OpenAI Group PBC 董事会主席布雷特·泰勒 (Bret Taylor) 在一份声明中表示。 “随着 OpenAI 为世界各地更多的企业和人们服务，努力确保人工智能惠及每个人，他们的经验将非常宝贵。”

Vélez 和 Vince 将与 OpenAI 现有的董事会成员一起任职，其中包括 Salesforce 前联合首席执行官 Taylor 和 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman。 Quora 首席执行官 Adam D'Angelo、长期担任医疗保健高管的 Sue Desmond-Hellmann 博士、卡内基梅隆大学教授 Zico Kolter、退役美国陆军将军 Paul Nakasone、Global Infrastructure Partners 联合创始人 Adebayo Ogunlesi 以及前索尼高管 Nicole Seligman 也是董事会成员。

Kolter 是唯一一位不以营利为目的在董事会任职的人。 OpenAI 在 10 月份表示，在资本重组后的一年内，第二位基金会董事将过渡到“专门在基金会董事会任职，并作为集团董事会的无投票权观察员”。

Altman 于 2023 年被短暂解除首席执行官职务，当时董事会成员认为他“在沟通中始终不坦诚”。经过几天戏剧性的谈判后，Altman 重新加入公司，并于 2024 年 3 月恢复董事会成员身份。

title: 高盛创建私募市场平台，富有投资者寻求下一个 SpaceX 和 Stripe
content:
据 CNBC 获悉，高盛创建了一个新平台，以扩大其为富裕客户和家族理财室提供的服务，这些客户和家族办公室越来越希望直接投资快速增长的私营公司。

根据 CNBC 最先看到的一份备忘录，这个名为另类投资平台的新团队将高盛现有的另类投资业务与两个新成立的团队结合起来。

新团队专注于对个体私营公司的直接投资，而不是更广泛的私募股权基金，并致力于帮助根据备忘录，客户买卖这些股份。

高盛财富另类投资业务全球主管克里斯汀·奥尔森 (Kristin Olson) 在接受 CNBC 采访时表示，“人们非常关注大型成长型科技公司，并让客户在它们在公开市场首次亮相之前就接触到这些公司。”

高盛的举动反映了重塑华尔街的两大趋势。该公司多年来一直在深入推进财富和资产管理业务，因为它被认为提供比投资银行和交易更稳定的收入。与此同时，最成功的初创公司保持私有状态的时间比以前长得多，这使得早期投资者能够在公共投资者有机会之前获得大部分收益。

“公司正在以万亿美元的价格上市，”奥尔森说。 “如果你没有一路参与，那么你显然错过了增长周期的很大一部分。”

大约二十年来，高盛一直在为富有的客户安排对后期私营公司的直接投资，奥尔森说，他指的是 2012 年首次公开募股之前的 Facebook，以及后来的 SpaceX、Stripe 和 Canva。但她补充说，对该资产类别的需求增长促使高管们突破了该业务。

奥尔森表示，该公司的目标是帮助客户在有前途的公司成为家喻户晓之前识别它们。

奥尔森表示，高盛通常不会瞄准处于早期阶段的初创公司，而是通常关注已开发产品、具有有意义的收入和更清晰的盈利路径的后期公司，寻求她所说的风险与回报之间的“最佳平衡点”。

人工智能投资繁荣只会加剧需求。奥尔森表示，除了领先的模型开发商之外，高盛还越来越多地引导客户投资支持人工智能的基础设施，包括数据中心和相关项目。

几天前，高盛公布了创纪录的季度收入，高管们强调了投资银行、交易和融资业务中人工智能驱动的活动。结果强化了投资者的观点，即高盛有望从人工智能投资周期的多个方面受益。

该公告还正式确定了高盛不断增长的业务，帮助客户为私人投资寻找流动性。

通过其新的二级咨询小组，该公司计划扩大一个市场，允许客户买卖私人持股，同时为寻求退出高盛以外持有的投资的客户提供建议。

“我们说，让我们打破这一点，并让我们将其非常明确地定义为我们正在关注的东西，”奥尔森说。

title: SpaceX 宣布新订单和保证金披露后，Super Micro 股价飙升 15%
content:

该公司表示，其毛利率和调整后毛利率应在 15% 至 17% 之间，较管理层 5 月份提供的 8.2% 至 8.4% 有所提高。

此次修订“主要是由于有利的客户和产品组合。”超微在一份初步业务更新中表示。

title: 埃隆·马斯克警告卖空者将无法生存，做空 SpaceX 的押注增至流通股的 32%
content:
埃隆·马斯克警告说，做空 SpaceX 的投资者几乎没有生存的机会——尽管在几个关键催化剂出现之前，卖空者将对该公司的押注提高到了该公司公开交易股票的约三分之一。

根据 S3 的估计，目前约有 2.06 亿股 SpaceX 股票被卖空，约占该公司可公开交易流通股的 32%，名义看跌押注约为 250 亿美元合作伙伴。这比上周的约 1.85 亿股（占流通量的 29%）有所增加，也比一个月前估计的 4000 万股（占流通量的大约 5% 至 7%）大幅增加。

“我们继续看到卖空者在即将到来的几个关键催化剂之前增加敞口，包括该公司作为上市公司的第一份收益报告和随后的禁售期到期，”S3 研究主管 Matthew Unterman 表示。 CNBC。

马斯克在 X 上的一篇帖子中回应了日益增长的空头兴趣，预测做空该公司的投资者最终会失败。

“随着时间的推移，在 SpaceX 中保持大量空头头寸的公司的生存概率非常低，”马斯克写道。 “我说过，如果我们实现我们的目标，SpaceX 的价值将超过地球。这显然是对的。”

SpaceX 周二证实，它将在 8 月 4 日美国股市收盘后发布其作为上市公司的第一份季度收益报告。该结果将使投资者首次详细了解 SpaceX 自首次公开募股以来的表现，并可能为多头和空头提供新的考验。

在投资者权衡 SpaceX 的长期前景及其价值之际，看空头寸不断增加。估值以及禁售限制到期后获得额外股份的可能性。看多者指出该公司在发射服务、星链扩张及其人工智能野心方面的领先地位，而怀疑者则质疑该股已经反映了多少未来增长。

在麦格理分析师重申其跑赢大盘评级并敦促投资者买入近期疲软后，SpaceX 股价周二上涨约 3%，结束了连续七个交易日的下跌。该股攀升至 124 美元左右，但在上市后大幅回调后仍低于 135 美元的 IPO 价格。

title: 加密货币卷土重来的时候了？交易员押注这只股票将引领潮流
content:
标准普尔 500 指数在五天内几乎没有变动，但加密资产正在获得一些动力。比特币周二跳涨，达到 6 月中旬以来的最高水平。

这是否是加密货币多头等待近一年的卷土重来？与数字资产类别相关的股票期权交易员似乎也这么认为，纷纷买入 theiShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT)、Michael Saylor'sStrategy，尤其是交易平台运营商 Coinbase Global。

Coinbase 股价在本月初跌破 150 美元后，周二上涨约 11%，至 178 美元左右，该股自 2024 年初以来已多次测试并保持这一水平。该股非常看涨，看涨期权交易量超过 114,000 份，看跌期权交易量略低于 50,000 份。看涨期权的买入量多于卖出量，看涨期权的买入量是看跌期权的四倍多。

根据 SpotGamma 的数据，截至周二中午，Coinbase 上交易的期权溢价超过 1 亿美元，其中 8000 万美元与看涨合约相关。按交易量计算，最受欢迎的合约是周五到期的 190 次执行看涨期权，该交易需要上涨 7.5% 才能获得回报。

Robinhood Markets 中的期权反映了 Coinbase 的看涨情绪。 ThinkOrSwim 的数据显示，在经纪股票交易的 170,000 份合约中，有 125,000 份是看涨期权，看涨期权的购买量是看跌期权的六倍。

如果加密货币价格回升，对经纪人的看涨押注最有可能获得回报，围绕比特币 ETF IBIT 的期权流动表明情况可能如此。在该基金中，买入看涨期权的数量是看跌期权的两倍多，尽管卖出的看涨期权多于买入的看涨期权，这表明前景更加中性至看涨。

比特币多头可能会松一口气的一点是：交易员在Strategy中买入的看涨期权是看跌期权的两倍，这家比特币财务公司在过去一年里下跌了75%以上，可以说是加密货币冲突的主要根源。

title: RFK Jr. 表示环孢菌爆发已“得到控制”
content:
美国卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.) 周二表示，正在发生的环孢子虫病疫情“已得到控制”。

肯尼迪在新闻发布会上回答有关医疗保健欺诈的问题时表示，“我们已经确定了疫情爆发的源头，相关公司也已实施召回。”

美国食品药品监督管理局 (FDA) 和疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 均在肯尼迪担任 HHS 部长的职权范围内，因对疫情的反应而受到批评。批评者批评联邦机构未能及时向公众发出警报并追查来源，他们将其与农产品巨头泰勒农场供应的墨西哥中部卷心生菜丝联系起来。

一些人声称特朗普政府的机构削减阻碍了调查，尽管环孢子虫寄生虫本身由于潜伏期长而带来了挑战。

“这些批评是无效的，”肯尼迪在简报中回答一个问题时说。关于对他领导下的裁员的批评。 “我们没有削减监测计划。我们确实削减了 FoodNet 计划，但它们是为了冗余监测。”

FoodNet（即食源性疾病主动监测网络）去年由于资金削减而停止了对八种病原体中的六种（包括环孢子虫）的强制报告。该组织是 CDC、FDA、10 个州卫生部门和美国农业部之间的合作组织。

FDA 得出的结论是，当前的环孢菌爆发与卷心生菜有关，其中一些卷心生菜是由百胜餐饮集团旗下的 Taco Bell 提供的。泰勒农场已召回与疫情相关的产品，而塔可钟已将其从其餐厅下架。

然而，该机构在调查期间发布的有关泰勒农场生菜样本环孢子虫检测呈假阳性的消息引发了混乱，导致 FDA 于周一发布澄清声明。该公司表示，仍然怀疑该公司的卷心生菜是疫情的源头。

美国疾病控制和预防中心 (CDC)、美国食品药品管理局 (FDA) 和多个州的公共卫生官员一直在调查此次疫情，疾病首次出现于 5 月 13 日。据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 称，迄今为止，已报告超过 1,644 例病例，其中 94 人住院治疗，无死亡病例。

title: 工会计划因火车安全问题举行铁路罢工
content: 图片来源，Getty Images 图片说明，RMT 工会表示，自 4 月份推出 810 车队以来，它一直与东米德兰铁路公司存在争议。作者：交通通讯记者凯蒂·奥斯汀 (Katy Austin) 和东米德兰兹郡丹·亨特 (Dan Hunt) 3 小时前发布 代表铁路员工的工会宣布，东米德兰铁路公司 (EMR) 的成员计划就“公司未能解决日益严重的安全问题”采取罢工行动。RMT 工会表示，已自 4 月份推出 810 车队（Aurora）以来，该公司与 EMR 一直存在争议，据称该车队在运营中出现了“大量”故障。该公司表示，其成员计划在 8 月 1 日星期六和随后的两个星期六采取罢工行动。EMR 发言人表示，任何有关日立铁路 810 级车队不符合所需安全标准的说法都是“不正确的”，并补充说，该公司将继续“与 RMT 就这一纠纷进行讨论”。 上周，EMR表示，由日立铁路制造的新型 Aurora（810 级）列车的可靠性和维护问题是罪魁祸首。EMR 还概述了 810 型和较旧的 222 级列车的“挑战”，影响了厕所、空调和餐饮设备。它补充说，222 级列车还需要“额外的维护支持，以适应增加的运行和操作要求”。运营商首次将 Aurora 列车引入客运服务是在12 月，在 EMR 所说的三年延误之后。“极其耐心”根据 RMT 的说法，EMR 已将“可能会发生故障并需要完全重置的列车投入使用，这使得列车没有主动安全系统”。BBC 看到了一份操作简报，其中通知控制、信号和操作人员对 EMR 810 级设备进行辅助关闭/辅助开启重置，这可能需要恢复某些故障。 20 分钟内，导致多个安全关键系统暂时丢失，增加了失控疏散的风险，并消除了驾驶员与信号员的正常通信方式。”RMT 秘书长埃迪·登普西 (Eddie Dempsey) 表示，EMR 的 RMT 代表一直“非常耐心”，并试图与管理层接触。“该公司甚至发布了安全通知，但没有与代表最危险人群的代表进行参与、协商或谈判。” EMR 发言人表示，日立铁路 810 级列车在“成功完成所有必需的测试并满足严格的安全标准”后进入客运服务。“我们认识到 810 级列车在使用中遇到了性能和可靠性问题，正在与制造商日立铁路合作，尽快解决这些问题。”EMR 发言人补充说，新列车的推出810 车队将在今年剩余时间和 2027 年继续“以受控方式”运行。日立铁路发言人表示：“810 级车队自 2025 年 12 月以来一直在东米德兰兹铁路提供客运服务，目前超过三分之一的车队已交付。”在 810 级车队投入使用阶段，日立铁路将继续与所有行业合作伙伴密切合作，实施改进并支持从现有车队过渡到新车队。极光列车。“随着更多新列车投入客运服务，我们仍然专注于交付剩余的车队并支持东米德兰铁路。作为这一承诺的一部分，我们正在投资于长马斯顿铁路创新中心的额外测试活动，以改善剩余列车的车队引入和交付。“联系我们，告诉我们应该在莱斯特报道哪些故事联系表收听 BBC 莱斯特广播电台的 Sounds 并在 Facebook、外部、onX、外部或 Instagram、外部关注 BBC 莱斯特。将您的故事想法发送至 eastmidsnews@bbc.co.uk，外部或通过 WhatsApp、externalon 0808 100 2210.相关话题德比郡东米德兰铁路更多关于这个故事铁路公司概述了火车持续存在的问题发布13小时前东米德兰铁路取消 - 这真的只是天气炎热吗？发布5天前坏空调让火车“里面下雨”发布6天前相关互联网链接东米德兰铁路

title: B&M 伯明翰商店因严重食品卫生问题被罚款 200 万英镑
content: 图片来源，GettyImage说明，伯明翰三家商店发现老鼠出没的证据作者克莱尔·利萨曼西米德兰发布于2026年7月21日，英国夏令时间16:06更新于6分钟前B&M Retail Ltd因伯明翰三家商店的老鼠出没而被罚款200万英镑，检查人员在儿童玩具附近发现了啮齿动物啃咬的食品和粪便。伯明翰市议会在投诉导致 2024 年 11 月至 2025 年 10 月期间进行检查后，因食品卫生违规而被起诉。市议会表示，检查地点包括圣安德鲁零售公园，官员们在那里发现了在售的被啃咬的产品。 Priory Square 购物中心和 The Fort 购物公园也发现了老鼠出没的情况。B&M 表示“对所发现的问题深表歉意”，并已采取全面行动“加强对整个业务的控制”。该委员会表示，投诉中包括一位“报告在 Priory Square 的商店里看到老鼠”的公众。其他违规行为包括食品包装和货架上啮齿动物的尿液污染、清洁标准不足以及允许害虫进入的结构缺陷。卫生紧急情况该委员会表示，禁止通知已发出，商店立即关闭。在收到有关老鼠出没的投诉后，2025 年 10 月 27 日，对位于埃尔丁顿 Fort 购物公园的 B&M 商店进行了进一步检查。该委员会表示，官员们在整个店内发现了老鼠活动的广泛证据，包括“靠近展示的儿童玩具”的老鼠粪便。由于对公共健康构成风险，该商店也被关闭。图片来源，盖蒂图片说明，委员会圣安德鲁零售公园是环境卫生官员访问的三个地点中的第一个，并跟踪了“该场所的害虫报告”。该委员会表示，2024 年 11 月 11 日前往该地点的官员发现了老鼠活动的重要证据，并导致发出卫生紧急禁止通知。该公司在伯明翰地方法院承认了这些罪行，并被罚款在 7 月 13 日的量刑听证会上，B&M Retail Limited 还被勒令支付 18,104 英镑的起诉费用和 2,000 英镑的受害者附加费。被告知要在 28 天内支付罚款和费用。“居民正确地期望在伯明翰经营的企业保持高标准并为顾客提供安全的环境，”许可和公共保护委员会主席、议员萨姆·福赛斯 (Sam Forsyth) 说。她说，环境卫生官员发现这三家商店的情况“不可接受，需要立即干预以保护公众”。福赛斯补充道：“法庭的巨额处罚反映了罪行的严重性，并发出了一个明确的信息：企业B&M在一份声明中表示：“我们对这三家商店发现的问题深表歉意，并承担全部责任。”虽然每家商店都制定了食品安全和虫害控制程序，但这些程序并未得到遵守。 That should not have happened.我们认识到这些失败是不可接受的，我们必须从中吸取教训。”一位发言人表示，该公司已采取“全面行动，加强对整个业务的控制”，其中包括加强管理监督、显着扩大其害虫防治能力、新的数字监控流程以及增加其整个庄园的第三方害虫防治访问。他们补充说，这些变化旨在使问题得到及时、一致的解决。他们补充说：“我们仍然完全致力于满足食品安全的高标准，并保持安全、清洁和卫生的商店。”告诉我们我们应该报道伯明翰和黑人国家的哪些故事联系表在BBC Sounds、Facebook、外部、X、外部和Instagram、外部关注BBC伯明翰。相关主题伯明翰相关故事B&M被告知要删除市中心的“花哨”标志发布2025年10月17日发布商店突击搜查中“大量”库存被盗发布发布2025年12月11日拆除工作开始于废弃购物中心2月20日发布互联网链接伯明翰市议会B&M商店

title: 谷歌扩大 Gemini 产品线，推出更便宜的型号和新的 Mythos 竞争对手
content:
Alphabet 周二发布了三款新的 Gemini 模型，其中包括迄今为止对 Anthropic 领先的网络安全领域最明确的答案，因为该公司希望展示面临延迟和竞争加剧的产品线的进展。

Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber​​ 旨在检测和修补软件漏洞，最初将通过有限访问试点仅向政府和值得信赖的合作伙伴提供。谷歌表示，与大型模型相比，专用模型的每个代币价格更低。

新模型可以帮助谷歌缩小与 Anthropic 的网络安全差距，Anthropic 凭借其 Mythos 模型在自动代码防御领域建立了早期领先地位。

谷歌还推出了 Gemini 3.6 Flash，它提高了编码、多模式和知识工作性能，同时比之前的模型使用的代币数量减少了 17%，每个代币的成本也更低，这显着降低了大批量运行的成本与此同时，Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 是 Google 3.5 系列中最快、最便宜的型号，专为大型 AI 代理系统中的大容量工作负载和小型任务而设计。

更广泛的产品阵容反映出 Google 的赌注，即价格和效率可以帮助抵消其在几个关键产品类别中较慢的时间安排。

人工分析数据显示，Gemini Flash 已经低于 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Chinese 的同类型号成本上的竞争对手。据该公司称，Gemini 3.6 Flash——Alphabet 新型号中最强的——每项任务的成本比 GPT-5.6 Terra Max、Kimi K3 和 Qwen 3.7 Max 更便宜。

此次推出是在 Alphabet 财报发布前夕，中国竞争对手势头强劲之际。 Moonshot AI 的 Kimi K3 吸引了足够的需求，以至于该公司由于容量限制而限制了新订阅和 API 访问，而阿里巴巴则推出了 Qwen 3.8 Max，据称其​​整体性能仅落后于 Anthropic 的《神鬼寓言 5》。

这种需求凸显了人工智能竞赛的另一面：建立有竞争力的模型只是挑战的一部分。公司还需要足够的计算能力来大规模服务。

谷歌通过其定制芯片、云基础设施以及一起设计模型和硬件的能力拥有潜在优势，尽管该公司面临着自身的容量限制。

周二的模型发布正值谷歌据称正在开发一种专用芯片，旨在将 Gemini 的运行效率提高 10 倍，这是降低人工智能服务成本的更广泛努力的一部分。

谷歌云发言人在一份声明中告诉 CNBC，其团队正在“不断研究和试验新的创新，为我们的用户和客户提供最高的性能和效率”，并且“虽然不是每个项目都投入生产，但这种严格的探索是我们全栈方法的核心。”

“通过从头开始共同设计我们的硬件和软件，我们确保我们的系统针对实际工作负载进行集成和高度优化，”声明继续说道。

在出现延迟问题后，Google 还提供了对其路线图的更多了解。 Gemini 3.5 Pro 目前正在与合作伙伴一起进行测试，以便在更广泛的可用性之前进行测试，同时该公司也已开始针对 Gemini 4 进行有史以来最大规模的预训练。

title: 随着传统技术和国防支出下滑，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 加大游说力度
content:
OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在 2026 年第二季度将联邦游说支出增加到创纪录水平，因为人工智能行业在中期选举之前和备受期待的 IPO 之前投入了数百万美元来影响华盛顿。

根据联邦游说，这两家领先的人工智能开发商在本季度总共花费了 317 万美元，比今年前三个月增长了 23%

Anthropic 从 4 月到 6 月花费了 197 万美元，比第一季度增长 26%。 OpenAI花费了120万美元，增长了近18%。这些公司报告了在网络安全、版权、云计算和国防采购等问题上的游说活动。

监控游说支出（公司必须每季度向国会报告）是衡量哪些公司和行业在影响联邦政府方面最积极的一种方法。对制定立法或监管感兴趣的公司通常会增加支出。

老牌技术和国防公司的总体支出仍然要高得多，但 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 正在缩小与华盛顿一些最大的企业游说业务的差距。

例如，Anthropic 在本季度的游说支出比英伟达更多，几乎与甲骨文的 200 万美元总额相当。 OpenAI 与 Nvidia 的支出相差 5 万美元，Nvidia 的支出为 125 万美元。

两家人工智能公司的支出也较去年第二季度大幅增加：Anthropic 的支出增加了一倍多，而 OpenAI 的支出几乎翻了一番。

CNBC 对五家“Magnificent 7”科技公司（Meta、亚马逊、谷歌、微软、苹果、Nvidia 和特斯拉）的分析发现，他们在第二季度的联邦游说支出与第一季度的 2127 万美元基本持平。

Meta 仍然是第二季度支出最多的支出方，达 599 万美元，尽管其游说支出较今年第一季度下降了 15%。亚马逊的支出几乎没有变化，为 436 万美元。

谷歌和微软则朝相反的方向发展。谷歌的支出比上季度增加了 25%，达到 357 万美元，而微软的支出总额增加了近 13%，达到 269 万美元。

由于科技一直受到国会山的关注，这些公司的游说支出与 2025 年第二季度相比总共增加了 7.7%。他们报告称，最近一个季度就贸易、中国、税收和出口管制等问题进行了游说。

大型国防承包商（另一个像科技这样习惯性大手笔的行业）减少了其综合支出。

与上一季度相比，美国最大的八家上市国防承包商按照美国总务管理局 SAM.gov 最新 100 家承包商报告中的 2024 财年国防部合同义务进行了排名。第二季度的联邦游说费用为 1,968 万美元，比第一季度的 2,036 万美元下降了 3.3%。

洛克希德·马丁公司以 418 万美元领先，其次是 RTX，为 386 万美元，通用动力为 342 万美元。

RTX 削减了 60 万美元的支出，这是受审查的国防公司中从第一季度到第二季度的最大降幅。据 CNBC 报道。L3Harris 报告称，其支出下降幅度最大，减少了近 45%，至 53 万美元。亨廷顿·英格尔斯 (Huntington Ingalls)、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司 (Northrop Grumman) 和莱多斯 (Leidos) 也出现了两位数的下降。

波音公司是八家公司中支出增幅最大的公司，支出增加了 13%，至 277 万美元。

title: 在计划扩大航班的情况下，机场真的能实现碳中和吗？
content: Image caption,All the cars and buses at the airport run on green electricity, but the planes still use fossil fuelsByDave Harvey,ÂWest of England business and environment correspondentÂandÂMatty Edwards,ÂBristolPublished21 July 2026Giant heat pumps, electric vehicles, and new fuel efficient planes are being ordered by an airport introducing major changes to cut its carbon emissions.But climate campaigners say the measures "barely touch the surface" of the problem. They say 99% of the carbon emitted by the airport is from planes, and have urged council leaders to reject plans to allow the airport to expand its flights.Mary Collett, from Bristol Airport Action Network, said: "With the weather like this at the moment, the unbearable heat, the fact that we can't grow food as easily, we just can't carry on expanding airports, we all just need to fly a bit less."But like many regional airports, Bristol is keen to expand, and has applied to grow from 12 million passengers a year to 15 million, which airport bosses insist can be done "sustainably".Dave Lees, the airport's chief exec, said new planes are greener than ever, and that Bristol will be "the first airport to be net zero by 2030" - but crucially this does not account for emissions from flights.Image caption,Lees says the airport is on "a journey to net zero"More from BristolDad facing difficult summer as food donations plungePublished1 day agoFormer Victorian baths illuminated for first eventPublished1 day agoDarren Jones sacked from cabinetPublished1 day agoPeople's desire to travel seems limitless, with airlines able to sell more flights to more destinations. The UK Government has backed expansion of regional airports to "drive economic growth".But as the impact of a changing climate is felt in repeated heatwaves, droughts and wildfires this summer, how can we fly around the world without costing the earth?Greener planes?Right now, councillors in North Somerset, Bristol Airport's local authority, are reading anambitious expansion plan.Airport chiefs wants to add another 15,000 flights a year, raising their cap to 100,000.This means a bigger terminal building, and controversial new landing lights on ancient common land next to the airport.Many of the new flights are on EasyJet planes, and the airline has invested in new aircraft which it says cuts fuel use, and so carbon emissions.The Airbus NEO jets, with wings designed nearby in Filton and built in the UK, have cut fuel consumption by 20%.Kevin Doyle, EasyJet's UK manager, said: "Our roadmap is by 2050 to get to net zero, and this aircraft very much helps us on that path."Within Bristol we've actually got 13 of the 20 aircraft that are here from that next generation," he said.Image caption,Collett is calling on political leaders to reject Bristol Airport's expansion plansBut climate campaigners insist any cut in the fuel used per aircraft would be "overwhelmed" by the increase in flights.Collett said: "When they are adding another 15,000 extra flights, being more fuel efficient isn't going to make much difference."People are flying on holiday to places where there are wildfires, where they can't go out of their hotel. What kind of world are we building here?"A 'Zero Carbon Airport'?Bristol Airport has pledged to become carbon neutral by 2030 by switching to electric vehicles, and powering the site with solar panels and 22 new industrial scale heat pumps.But this net zero target does not include emissions from flights. These vastly outweigh the amount of carbon produced by the airport site, and are accounted for separately by airlines."We're on a journey towards that transition to net zero," said Lees."It's not just a quick flick of the switch. That's going to take some years, and for aviation there are lots of levers we're pulling."Image caption,Workers are building a Â£10m energy centre to heat and cool the airport terminal using renewable electricity instead of gas.Members of campaign group Bristol Airport Action Network have welcomed the renewable energy improvements, but insist they are not the real problem."It's the aircraft. Aviation is the hardest sector to decarbonise, so we cannot carry on expanding airports," Collett added.In 2024, Bristol Airport's direct carbon emissions were the equivalent of 3,680 tonnes of CO2, compared with 682,167 tonnes from indirect emissions including flights. That's equivalent to driving 2.12 billion miles (3.41 billion km) in a car - enough to circle the Earth around 85,000 times.TheUK Climate Change Committee,externalhas estimated that by 2040 aviation will account for a quarter of the country's carbon emissions. This is because other sectors are switching to renewable energy faster, and aviation has no realistic alternative to jet fuel from oil.Meanwhile theMet Office has said,externalthat the summer's heatwaves, which have "smashed records", are becoming more frequent and intense due to human-caused climate change.'Just fly less'For campaigners, the only solution is to fly less and limit airport expansions until planes can run on genuinely renewable fuel, like electricity or possibly hydrogen.Collett said: "With the weather like this at the moment, the unbearable heat, the fact that we can't grow food as easily, we just can't carry on expanding airports, we all just need to fly a bit less."Image caption,Campaigners protested against Bristol Airport's latest expansion plans, which would see the number of flights increase from 86,000 to 100,000 a yearBut the UK government has explicitly backed the expansion of regional airports outside London as a"driver of economic growth",external.For aviation bosses, cutting carbon emissions as much as they can is an imperative. EasyJet, and other airlines, are investing in the latest, more fuel-efficient aircraft.Standing by his new jet as passengers stream on to it, bound for a summer break in Croatia, Kevin Doyle from EasyJet defends putting more planes into the sky."There's a passenger demand for it," he insists. "That's why we've got our flights. And with the new aircraft, they are more fuel efficient than ever."Get in touchTell us which stories we should cover in BristolContact formFollow BBC Bristol onFacebook,external,X,externalandInstagram,external. title: 贝森特称美国可能因人工智能模型“盗窃”而制裁中国
content:
美国财政部长斯科特·贝森顿周二表示，特朗普政府将调查中国的人工智能模型是否是从美国模型中提炼出来的，并表示政府不支持“知识产权盗窃”。

中国的开放权重模型正在对抗 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等美国公司的领先产品，引发了科技高管和政府官员对美国耐用性的担忧。在人工智能竞赛中处于领先地位。中国初创公司 Moonshot AI 本月早些时候发布了一款名为 Kimi K3 的新模型，该模型在某些行业基准上的表现优于这些公司。

“如果我们看到，特别是海外模型正在从我们伟大的公司窃取信息，我们就有能力因为这种盗窃行为而制裁他们，”贝森特周二告诉福克斯商业频道的“Mornings with Maria”。

Bessent 表示，这种盗窃行为的技术术语称为蒸馏，它是一种人工智能训练方法，使用现有更强模型的输出来构建小型、能力较差的模型。Anthropic 上个月致函美国参议院银行、住房和城市事务委员会，声称中国科技公司阿里巴巴对其进行了“迄今为止最大规模的蒸馏攻击”。

据路透社周二报道，美国和中国计划在 9 月份围绕人工智能举行会谈。报告称，Bessent 将代表美国参与讨论。

“我们在许多中国模型上发现了美国大语言模型的水印，这是不可接受的，”Bessent 周二表示。 “我们将在未来几天或几周内关注这个问题。”

但是近年来，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 都面临着盗窃指控。

Anthropic 同意在 9 月份支付 15 亿美元，以和解与一群作者的集体诉讼，这些作者指控该公司从盗版数据库中非法下载书籍。《纽约时报》于 2023 年起诉 OpenAI 和微软，指控这两家公司利用其知识产权训练模型侵犯了版权。

title: SpaceX设定盈利日期，引发数百万股股票首次禁售期满
content:
SpaceX 的股价周二上涨 7%，试图结束其首次盈利报告后连续 7 天的下跌，该报告恰逢大股禁售期到期。

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的航空航天和国防承包商周一宣布，8 月 4 日是其创纪录的首次公开募股后的首次盈利报告。该日期还触发了该公司独特的禁售期，允许内部人士比典型的 180 天期限更早开始出售股票。

SpaceX 采取了交错方式，允许内部人士提前出售部分股票，以防止大规模抛售和价格波动。第一份收益报告为投资者在第一个收益发布日（8 月 6 日）后的第二个完整交易日出售 20% 的符合条件的锁定股票（总计最多 9.115 亿股）铺平了道路。

如果该股在报告发布前 10 个交易日中有 5 个交易日的收盘价比 IPO 价格至少高出 30%，则可以额外释放 10% 的股票。

截至周一收盘， SpaceX 股价较 6 月 16 日每股 225.64 美元的盘中高点下跌了近一半，较同日收盘价 211.39 美元的历史最高价下跌了 43%。 据《福布斯》实时亿万富翁报道，截至 6 月 12 日，马斯克的净资产已飙升至 1 万亿美元以上，周一约为 7,860 亿美元。

最近几周，该股也成为卖空者的主要目标，看空头寸最后达到了该公司公众持股量的约三分之一。

鉴于禁售期，只有一小部分股票可供交易，随着该股暴跌，卖空者一直在加大押注。周一，马斯克在 apostto 社交媒体平台 X 上对该组织进行了猛烈抨击。

他写道：“随着时间的推移，在 SpaceX 中保持大量空头头寸的公司的生存概率非常低。”

在周一起飞前取消了任务后，SpaceX 计划于周二将搭载 24 颗星链卫星的猎鹰 9 号火箭发射到低轨道。

这是 SpaceX 在一周内第二次取消发射。该公司计划在上周因发动机点火故障而停止任务后于周四发射其大型星舰火箭。

马斯克在 SpaceX 旗下的社交网络 X 上发帖称，“部分发动机无法启动，导致发射自动中止。”该公司表示正在修改火箭的推进系统以解决发动机问题。

在 SpaceX 筹集了创纪录的 857 亿美元资金后，投资者正在密切关注星舰试飞。 6 月份有史以来规模最大的首次公开募股，股价为 135 美元。

这枚巨型火箭是有史以来建造或飞行过的最大的火箭，是 SpaceX 扩大 Starlink 卫星互联网服务雄心的关键，也是履行美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯计划各项义务的关键，该计划的目标是在 2028 年将宇航员带回月球表面。

马斯克还称 Starship 为太空的“圣杯”旅行，并希望有一天看到它用于太空旅游和载人火星任务。

投资者也在关注 SpaceX 不断增长的云计算合同。该公司于 2 月份收购了马斯克的人工智能企业 xAI（现称为 SpaceXAI），成为大孟菲斯地区庞大数据中心和发电厂的所有者和运营商。

Google、Anthropic 和 Reflection 已签约从 SpaceXAI（xAI 公司现在的名称）租用这些设施中的多余计算能力。据报道，该公司还在谈判向五角大楼提供计算能力。

马斯克的第一家上市公司特斯拉预计将在周三盘后公布收益。机构投资者已通过 Say Technologies 网站提前向特斯拉领导层提出了一些问题。

在与 SpaceX 相关的话题中，特斯拉投资者想知道两家公司计划如何在 Terafab 上进行合作。Terafab 是马斯克计划在德克萨斯州格莱姆斯县建造的一家芯片工厂，特斯拉预计将在那里主导研发，SpaceX 预计将主导生产。

正如 CNBC 此前报道的那样，许多马斯克的粉丝希望看到他的帝国得到巩固，并看到 SpaceX 和特斯拉的合作。在某个时刻合并。 SpaceX 首席运营官兼总裁格温·肖特韦尔 (Gwynne Shotwell) 告诉 CNBC，这样做会让马斯克的生活变得更轻松。

title: Ozempic制造商指责竞争对手虚假广告
content: 图片来源，Getty Images作者：Michael RaceBusiness记者，纽约报道发布2026年7月21日，英国夏令时14:47更新1小时前Wegovy和Ozempic的制造商诺和诺德(Novo Nordisk)已发起法律诉讼，指控其主要竞争对手礼来(Eli Lilly)在宣传其减肥药效果更好方面进行虚假广告。这家丹麦公司周二在美国提起诉讼，指控礼来(Eli Lilly)，这使得礼来(Eli Lilly) Mounjaro 和 Zepbound 开展广告活动，“营造一种误导性印象，认为礼来公司的药物更优越”。诺和诺德表示，其竞争对手将其治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病药物的最高批准剂量与诺和诺德的较低剂量进行了比较，而忽略了更新的、更高剂量的选择。礼来公司回击了这些说法，并表示它“坚定地支持我们的广告”。该公司发言人表示：“我们将继续关注科学，并积极应对这起诉讼。”该诉讼发生之际，制药巨头诺和诺德和礼来公司正在争夺快速增长的减肥药物行业的主导地位，特别是在美国，分析师估计到 2030 年该行业的价值将超过 1000 亿美元。诺和诺德声称其减肥药物业务的主要竞争对手犯下了“多项违法行为”。该公司表示，礼来公司目前的广告活动“故意”选择了过时的研究，将礼来公司的最高剂量与诺和诺德较低剂量的药物进行比较。该公司表示，这些广告“欺骗性地”展示了礼来公司的产品优越，但掩盖或忽略了“关键的临床背景”。据诺和公司称，被错误比较的产品是 Mounjaro 与 Ozempic 和 Zepbound诺和诺德高级副总裁兼集团总法律顾问 John F. Kuckelman 表示：“随着新的、更有效的治疗方案的出现，人们应该得到反映最新科学证据的准确信息，帮助他们做出明智的护理决定。”他说，“医疗保健公司有责任保持其公开声明的准确性和最新性——无效的、精美的免责声明并不能消除重大全国性活动所造成的误导性印象。”诺和诺德表示，它正在寻求法院命令，要求礼来公司撤回其广告和广告。它补充说，如果礼来公司不自愿删除这些广告，它将在未来几天内提出动议，寻求初步禁令来阻止这些广告。但礼来公司指责诺和公司要求法院阻止该公司传达其所说的“稳健设计”和“黄金标准”的比较试验结果。相关主题肥胖减肥公司

title: 通用汽车在电动汽车撤退之际推出新款汽油动力凯迪拉克汽车
content:
底特律——通用汽车公司将从明年春天开始推出新型汽油动力凯迪拉克汽车，该汽车制造商将继续转向全电动汽车。

通用汽车首席执行官玛丽巴拉周二表示，下一代凯迪拉克汽车将包括该公司 CT5 轿车的新版本、过时的 XT5 中型 SUV 和停产的三排 XT6SUV。

“开始下一步从春季到 2028 年，我们将开始推出下一代凯迪拉克 ICE（内燃机）汽车，”巴拉在公司第二季度财报电话会议上表示。她表示，这些车辆将是凯迪拉克目前的全电动跨界车和凯雷德 SUV 的补充。

新产品的发布加剧了通用汽车在电动汽车领域的缩减。该汽车制造商计划在本世纪末让凯迪拉克独家销售电动汽车。该公司还取消了其他品牌的电动汽车计划，并增加了汽油发动机的生产，包括 V-8 产品。

自去年下半年以来，通用汽车已记录了 109 亿美元的电动汽车相关费用，原因是电动汽车的采用速度低于预期，以及美国监管变化放宽了排放标准并取消了对电动汽车的支持。

博拉重申，通用汽车的计划包括在底特律“将大量制造业务外包”。汽车制造商从明年开始，部分是将其全尺寸 SUV 的生产扩大到密歇根工厂，该工厂此前计划生产电动汽车。

全尺寸 SUV——Escalade、Chevy Tahoe 和 Suburban、GMC Yukon 和 Yukon XL——目前在该公司位于德克萨斯州的阿灵顿装配工厂独家生产。

title: 格里尔暗示特朗普将对数十个国家征收新关税：“预计很快就会采取行动”
content:
美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周二表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统的另一轮关税即将实施。

当被问及是否即将征收新关税时，格里尔告诉 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”，鉴于英国《金融时报》的报道称，最快本周可能会宣布更多关税。

“我现在无法真正确定时间表。我有责任在真正确定之前向国会和其他利益相关者通报情况。格里尔指出。

“但我们确实预计很快会采取行动，”他补充道。

这些评论表明，特朗普政府可能准备实施新关税，就像特朗普的其他一些进口税将于周五失效一样。

特朗普于 2 月份根据 1974 年贸易法第 122 条征收了 10% 的全面关税，而就在最高法院驳回了他的全面关税数小时后。 “解放日”关税制度。第 122 条关税将于美国东部时间周五中午 12:01 到期，除非国会进行干预，但国会似乎不太可能这样做。

但特朗普政府已采取措施加强其关税制度。

6 月初，美国贸易代表办公室提议对来自 60 个经济体的进口产品征收高达 12.5% 的关税。这些新关税是根据 1974 年贸易法的另一条款（即第 301 条）征收的，旨在应对所谓的强迫劳动问题。

“美国有法律禁止使用强迫劳动进行商品贸易，”格里尔在周二的采访中表示。 “其他国家大多数都没有法律。有法律的国家也没有真正执行。”

格里尔表示，拟对 60 个国家征收的 301 项关税将涵盖“我们约 99% 的贸易”。

“这实际上说明了我们面临的问题的严重程度，”他说。

title: 瑞安航空窗户破裂可能是由“异物”造成的
content: 图标题，观看：瑞安航空飞机内部，窗户脱落，作者：Emer Moreau 商业记者 3 小时前发布 瑞安航空一架航班发生事故，一名乘客被部分吸出飞机窗户，航空公司老板表示，这可能是由发动机“异物损坏”造成的。迈克尔·奥利里 (Michael O'Leary) 表示，对 7 月 10 日希腊和德国之间发生的事件进行的初步调查表明，“看起来像是异物在起飞时对发动机造成的损坏”塞萨洛尼基，但是……我们不能肯定地说这一点”。他坚称，这架已有 18 年历史的波音 737 飞机的发动机在过去两年里已得到全面保养和大修。塞尔维亚国民 Ljubisa Karoviä 的头部和右肩被吸出飞机的窗户，使他“严重受伤并处于休克状态”。他的妻子 Svetlana Grkoviä马克西莫维告诉 BBC 塞尔维亚电视台，她和另外两名乘客抓住了他的腿几分钟。她说：“我们把他拉了回来。他的整个脸都变形了，血从他的鼻子和嘴里涌出来。”飞机紧急着陆后，他被送往医院。乘客告诉当地媒体，他们听到机上有“某种爆炸声”。这架飞机由瑞安航空子公司马耳他航空运营。确认损坏是由外部物体造成的，可能会影响瑞安航空或波音公司对此事件的责任。美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）正在调查。奥利里表示，报告草稿将在大约 28 天后发布。相关主题航空旅行航空事故和事件旅行瑞安航空公司更多关于这个故事“如果我们死了，我们一起死”：差点从瑞安航空飞机上吸出来的男人的妻子讲述了磨难发表于 6 天前

content:
Jefferies 表示，Meta 拥有“数十亿美元”的机会

Jefferies 表示，Meta 很可能通过利用与其人工智能驱动的智能眼镜相关的“数十亿美元”收入机会实现反弹。该投资公司对该技术名称给予买入评级。该公司的目标股价还为 825 美元，较周一收盘价上涨近 28%。分析师布伦特·蒂尔（Brent Thill）周一在给客户的一份报告中表示：“虽然我们看到有待改进的领域，但 META 作为目前唯一一家大规模出货的厂商，拥有先发优势……[并且]我们看到了数十亿美元的硬件收入机会”。 “假设 Apple Watch 的平均售价 (ASP) 为 400 美元，我们预计未来几年内硬件[收入]机会将达到 14B-18B 美元，并且[长期]增长向量尚未计入价格，”他补充道。 Meta 于六月下旬推出了最新系列的智能眼镜。它包括三种型号：Meta Adventurer、Fury 和 Glasses by Kylie。随着 Meta 眼镜佩戴者数量的持续增长，它们首次亮相。杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 表示，这款眼镜的日常使用者数量同比增长了两倍。与此同时，据该投资公司称，其最新可穿戴技术产品的产能将在 2026 年激增至 2000 万件。蒂尔指出，与人工智能相关的高价值订阅和广告可能会为 Meta 带来额外的上涨空间。他补充说，从长远来看，与智能眼镜相关的商业货币化机会也可能成为 Meta 的最大上涨来源之一。 “从长远来看，更大的价值是商业：如果代理人工智能从浏览转向委托，人工智能眼镜可以在发现时捕获用户意图，使 Meta 更接近交易，”分析师写道。杰富瑞的呼吁符合华尔街的共识。 LSEG 数据显示，在研究 Meta 的 65 名分析师中，有 57 名对该股给予买入或强烈买入评级。过去一年，该公司股价下跌约 9%，表现逊于整体市场。

title: 波音要求美国干预欧盟向空客提供创纪录的贷款：路透社
content:
波音要求美国干预欧盟向空客提供创纪录的贷款：路透社

2025 年 11 月 17 日在迪拜举行的 2025 年迪拜航展期间，一架波音 777-9 停在阿勒马克图姆国际机场的停机坪上。（摄影：Giuseppe CACACE / 法新社）（摄影：GIUSEPPE） CACACE/法新社（来自盖蒂图片社）

已要求美国政府向欧盟施压，要求其提供 30 亿欧元（34.3 亿美元）贷款方案的透明度

，在双方就喷气式飞机补贴问题达成关税休战协议后，潜在的贸易紧张局势再次浮出水面。

美国政府请求干预之际，空中客车公司提出了干预请求双方一直在谈论最早在 2030 年开发一款新飞机，这可能会在全球喷气机市场引发新一波竞争。

双方在世界贸易组织长达 17 年的飞机补贴斗争中取得了部分胜利，这场斗争导致了一波跨大西洋关税打击其他行业，随后双方达成了为期五年的休战协议。 2021 年。

原定于 7 月 6 日到期的休战协议已无限期延长，因为双方都退出了新一轮的航空航天贸易战。

路透社看到，波音公司在给美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔的一封信中表示，它对欧盟贷款机构欧洲投资银行 6 月 29 日的声明感到惊讶，该声明承诺为其有史以来最大的一笔贷款

它要求美国贸易代表办公室要求欧盟“全面核算这笔贷款的条款”，并解释为什么它符合2021年停战协议，该协议要求“公开透明的程序”。

波音公司指出，这项包括首期10亿欧元贷款的公告是在欧盟做出延长停顿决定的四天后发布的。波音公司在信中表示，“至少，这笔贷款的时机令人惊讶。”

欧洲投资银行表示，它每年为数千家公司提供融资，并否认向空中客车公司提供任何不寻常的支持。

“这是一笔正常的贷款，附带利息，是欧洲投资银行整体融资活动的一部分，”一位发言人表示。

美国贸易代表办公室和欧盟委员会没有立即回应置评请求。

欧洲投资银行在其贷款公告中表示，该贷款计划将支持空客到 2030 年的长期投资。

波音公司指出，空客首席执行官纪尧姆·福里 (Guillaume Faury) 也在同一年表示，空客计划开始开发 A320neo

在范堡罗航展前接受《航空周刊》采访时，福里谈到了 2030 年的一架新飞机，并透露了该项目的内部代号“eAction”。

“这笔巨额贷款的时机也与空客领导层公开承诺新飞机推出日期的言论相吻合，这进一步引发了人们对这一历史性经济援助的规模和意图的质疑波音公司在给美国贸易代表办公室的信中写道。

波音公司表示，市场条件尚不适合新一代飞机，尽管分析师称两家公司预计将在十年中期开始下一步的开发工作。

波音公司的信函强调了双方对资金的谨慎态度，尽管自世贸组织补贴以来紧张局势已大大缓解

特朗普政府在去年短暂对航空征收关税后，去年同意免除飞机和零部件关税。

华盛顿尚未正式表示将延长与空客-波音争端相关的单独关税休战期，但四名知情人士表示，双方暂时有效地埋葬了马拉松式的世贸组织争端

虽然特朗普政府一再使用关税，但人们认为它不愿意使用世贸组织工具，因为这些工具会隐式承认总统反对的多边规则。

特朗普本月呼吁与贸易伙伴进行谈判，以解决外国飞机进口的影响。

波音公司对欧盟向空客提供贷款的担忧也可能在这些谈判中提出，美国官员告诉路透社。欧洲消息人士称，类似的贷款在 WTO 争端中得到了解决。
